A full dark mode.\n- **Structure:** numbered nav, numbered sections, ISO dates in mono, square status badges, hairline tables, and square buttons with one solid action per view.\n\nAnd four usability changes:\n\n- **Navigation on every page:** 01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for the Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users. Plus who is signed in, \"View site ↗\", and Log out.\n- **Lists apart from forms:** each list is a table with Summaries, status badges, filters, and row actions. Creating an item opens its own page.\n- **A dashboard of what needs attention:** counts, \"Waiting for you\", and \"Recently changed\".\n- **An edit page laid out for work:** the fields and Editor beside a sticky Site preview, and a save bar pinned to the bottom.\n\n## User Stories\n\n1. As the Director, I want to see, on signing in, which draft Reports are waiting for me to publish, so that nothing sits unreviewed.\n2. As an Analyst, I want to see my own drafts first on the dashboard, so that I pick up where I left off, or where the last shift left off.\n3. As any user, I want the same navigation on every console page, so that I never hunt for a back-link.\n4. As any user, I want to log out from any page.\n5. As any user, I want each list to show every item's Summary, state, author, and last update, and to filter by state, so that I find an item without opening it.\n6. As any user, I want \"New Data Bite\" to open its own page, so that the list stays a list.\n7. As any user, I want the Site preview beside the fields while I edit, and Save always in reach, so that I don't scroll past a long body to save.\n8. As any user, I want to know when I have unsaved changes before I leave.\n9. As any user, I want an item's address shown as `data-bites/<slug>.html`, so that the slug is understandable.\n10. As any user on a laptop at night, I want the console to follow dark mode.\n11. As a keyboard or screen-reader user, I want a skip link, a visible focus ring, labelled fields, and AA contrast in the console too.\n12. As the Director, I want the Users and Homepage pages to look and work like the rest of the console.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n### Shared (ADR-007 stays: two stylesheets, no rule crosses)\n\n- **`static/admin.css` is rewritten** as the console's own stylesheet. It copies the public tokens and the `@font-face` rules, and never links or imports `site.css`. No public rule may reach an admin page, and no admin rule may reach the public site (the T19 tests stay).\n- **Fonts:** `admin.css` is served at `/admin.css`, so its `url(\"fonts/…\")` resolves to `/fonts/…`, which the public route already serves. No new route and no new dependency.\n- **Class names** keep the repo's prefix rule: `.bar-console`, `.nav-console`, `.badge-state-draft`, `.table-items`, `.bar-save`. No bare `.title` or `.status`.\n- **The Editor and the Chart builder are restyled by class only.** `static/editor.js` keeps its markup, classes, and behaviour. In the console, Chart cards use the public site's purples and greys instead of today's blue and orange.\n- **No new database columns.** \"Waiting for you\" is derived from what is stored: a draft Report is waiting for the Director, and an Analyst's own drafts are theirs.\n- **Accessibility:** skip link, `:focus-visible` ring, labelled fields, and text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes, recorded in each closing comment.\n\n### T21: Console shell\n\n- `base.html` becomes the console layout:\n  - The slim bar with the IR mark and \"Console\".\n  - Numbered nav. Homepage and Users show only for a Director. `aria-current` marks the current section.\n  - The signed-in user's name and role, \"View site ↗\" to the public home, and Log out (a POST with CSRF) on every signed-in page.\n  - A skip link and the Confirmation, restyled.\n- On a phone, the nav scrolls sideways under the bar and never wraps, as on the public site.\n- The login, \"Not allowed\" (403), confirm-delete, Users, and Homepage settings pages move to the new look and type. They keep their behaviour.\n- Dark mode via `prefers-color-scheme`.\n\n### T22: Lists and create pages\n\n- `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports` become `table-items` tables:\n  - Columns: title with its Summary under it, a state badge, author, Updated (ISO), and row actions (Edit, Publish/Unpublish, and Delete for a Director). Each action is a POST with CSRF, as now.\n  - Filters: All / Published / Drafts, each with its count, via `?status=`. An unknown value is a 400, as on the All content page.\n  - A \"New Data Bite\" or \"New Report\" button in the page head.\n- The create forms move to `/admin/data-bites/new` and `/admin/reports/new`, laid out like the edit page. The POST target stays `/admin/data-bites` and `/admin/reports`.\n- **After a create, the redirect goes to the new item's edit page**, not the list. Tests that assert the old location are updated in the same commit, with the reason.\n- The All content page uses the same table.\n- Rows stack on a phone. The table keeps its semantics, as in T20's Reports table.\n\n### T23: Edit pages\n\n- Two columns at desktop width, one below 64rem:\n  - Left: Title (large), Summary with its count, the slug as an address field (`data-bites/` [slug] `.html`), and the Editor.\n  - Right: the Site preview with Desktop / Phone and \"Open ↗\", sticky.\n- **A save bar pinned to the bottom** shows the state badge, an \"Unsaved changes\" marker, Save, and Publish/Unpublish and Delete where the user may do them. Buttons outside the item's form use the `form=` attribute or their own small forms. No action may lose CSRF or the stale-form check (`item_base`).\n- The \"Unsaved changes\" marker follows the Editor's existing dirty state (`body_dirty`) and any field's `input` event.\n- A Report's PDF field and its chart images sit under the Editor.\n- A Report that is locked for an Analyst keeps today's read-only view, in the new layout.\n\n### T24: Dashboard\n\n- Head: \"Dashboard\", today's date, the user's role, and \"New Data Bite\" (plus \"New Report\").\n- Four counts (Data Bites published and drafts, Reports published and drafts), each linking to its filtered list.\n- **01 Waiting for you:**\n  - For a Director: draft Reports, oldest update first, each with \"Review\".\n  - For an Analyst: their own drafts, Data Bites and Reports.\n  - Empty, it says so.\n- **02 Recently changed:** the 8 most recently updated items of both kinds, with a state badge and an ISO date, and a link to All content.\n- **Side panels:** \"The public site\" (publishing reaches it at the next `cms publish`, plus \"View the site ↗\"), and, for a Director, \"Homepage\" (when it was last saved, plus \"Edit homepage\").\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- Existing tests keep passing. A test that asserts on today's console markup or a redirect location is updated in the same commit, with the reason.\n- New tests:\n  - Every signed-in console page has the nav and a Log out form with a CSRF token.\n  - An Analyst's nav has no Homepage or Users link.\n  - No admin page links `style.css`; no public page links `admin.css` (kept from T19).\n  - Each list's filter shows only that state, and a bad `?status=` is a 400.\n  - `/admin/data-bites/new` and `/admin/reports/new` render the form, and a create redirects to the new item's edit page.\n  - The edit page's save-bar buttons each post with a CSRF token. A stale form is still refused (409).\n  - \"Waiting for you\": a Director sees draft Reports and not published ones. An Analyst sees their own drafts and not another Analyst's. Nothing from it leaks to a public page.\n- **Browser check** in each closing comment, at 390, 768, and 1440 px in light and dark, with screenshots and `document.fonts`. That covers the nav, a list, a create, an edit with the save bar and the unsaved marker, the dashboard as the Director and as an Analyst, and the Users and Homepage pages.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- Any change to the public site.\n- New roles, a review or approval workflow, or a \"submit for review\" state. \"Waiting for you\" is derived from existing states.\n- Recording when `cms publish` last ran.\n- Search in the console.\n- Changes to the Editor's behaviour or the Chart builder's features. They are restyled only.\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- Mockup: `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/` (`index.html`, `data-bites.html`, `edit.html`, `console.css`, and `screenshots/`). Its CSS is the starting point for `static/admin.css`.\n- Stage 2 is due Tue Oct 6, 2:40 pm Eastern. The tickets are ordered so that each one leaves the console working and committed: T21, then T22, then T23, then T24.\n\n## Tickets\n\n- #26 T21: Console shell\n- #27 T22: Lists and create pages\n- #28 T23: Edit pages\n- #29 T24: Dashboard\n\n------\n# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**State**:\nWhether a Data Bite or Report is a Draft or Published. The Console's lists\nshow it as a badge and filter by it (spec #25, T22). In code and in the\nlists' `?status=`, it is `status`.\n_Avoid_: status (on a page), stage\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Summary**:\nOne or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200\ncharacters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title\non its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's\ndescription and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without\none shows nothing in its place.\n_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb\n\n**Homepage settings**:\nThe homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright\npurple), its intro, and its Key figures. Edited by the Director only, at\n/admin/homepage. Settings, not content: no Draft, and on the public site from\nthe next `cms publish`, like a change to the nav (spec #22, T20).\n_Avoid_: hero, homepage content\n\n**Key figure**:\nOne of up to four numbers on the homepage, each a value, a label saying what\nit counts, and an optional note saying when or of whom (e.g. \"1,805\" /\n\"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Console**:\nThe admin console: the local, signed-in app where the Director and Analysts\nwrite and publish content, never on the public internet. Every page has the\nsame bar: numbered nav (01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for\nthe Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users), who is signed in, \"View site ↗\",\nand Log out (spec #25, T21). Its home page is the **Dashboard**.\n_Avoid_: back end, dashboard (that is its home page only)\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"aadb8ace-5203-4352-90d0-2f04bbfbd2db","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":6},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b197f4bf-a0d8-4e8a-925d-c7869c1bd5f3","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"64357a30-87f1-41b4-b8f9-9b3ad7295b77","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

Created {{ bite.created_at }} by {{ bite.author_name }}.\n     6\t     Last updated {{ bite.updated_at }}.</p>\n     7\t  {% if error and not error_field %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n     8\t  {% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}\n     9\t  {% set action = \"/admin/data-bites/\" ~ bite.id %}\n    10\t  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n    11\t  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n    12\t  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n    13\t{% endblock %}\n=================== admin/report_edit.html\n     1\t{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n     2\t{% block content %}\n     3\t  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_reports') }}\">All Reports</a></p>\n     4\t  <h1>{{ \"Edit Report\" if can_edit else report.title }}</h1>\n     5\t  <p>{{ status_labels[report.status] }}. Created {{ report.created_at }} by {{ report.author_name }}.\n     6\t     Last updated {{ report.updated_at }}.</p>\n     7\t  {% if error and not error_field %}<p role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n     8\t  {% if can_edit %}{% include \"admin/_undescribed_images.html\" %}{% endif %}\n     9\t  <p>Attached file:\n    10\t    {% if report.file_name %}<a href=\"{{ path_for('download_file', report_id=report.id) }}\">{{ report.file_name }}</a>{% else %}none{% endif %}</p>\n    11\t  {% if can_edit %}\n    12\t  {% if report.file_name %}\n    13\t  <form method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/reports/{{ report.id }}/file/delete\">\n    14\t    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    15\t    <button type=\"submit\">Remove file</button>\n    16\t  </form>\n    17\t  {% endif %}\n    18\t  {% set action = \"/admin/reports/\" ~ report.id %}\n    19\t  {% set submit = \"Save changes\" %}\n    20\t  {% set file_label = (\"Replace\" if report.file_name else \"Attach\") ~ \" PDF (optional, up to \" ~ max_file_mb ~ \" MB)\" %}\n    21\t  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n    22\t  {% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}\n    23\t  {% else %}\n    24\t  <p>Only the Director can edit, unpublish, or delete a published Report.</p>\n    25\t  <p>Slug: <code>{{ report.slug }}</code></p>\n    26\t  {% with preview_path = none %}{% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}{% endwith %}\n    27\t  {% endif %}\n    28\t{% endblock %}\n=================== admin/data_bite_new.html\n     1\t{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n     2\t{% block content %}\n     3\t  <div class=\"head-page\"><div>\n     4\t    <span class=\"head-page-crumbs text-label\"><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Dashboard</a> / <a href=\"{{ path_for('list_bites') }}\">Data Bites</a> / New</span>\n     5\t    <h1>New Data Bite</h1>\n     6\t    <p class=\"head-page-lede\">Saved as a Draft. Nothing reaches the public site until it is published.</p>\n     7\t  </div></div>\n     8\t  {% if error and not error_field %}<p class=\"alert-console\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n     9\t  {% set action = path_for('create_bite') %}\n    10\t  {% set submit = \"Save draft\" %}\n    11\t  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n    12\t{% endblock %}\n=================== admin/report_new.html\n     1\t{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n     2\t{% block content %}\n     3\t  <div class=\"head-page\"><div>\n     4\t    <span class=\"head-page-crumbs text-label\"><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Dashboard</a> / <a href=\"{{ path_for('list_reports') }}\">Reports</a> / New</span>\n     5\t    <h1>New Report</h1>\n     6\t    <p class=\"head-page-lede\">Saved as a Draft. {% if user.role == \"admin\" %}It reaches the public site once you publish it.{% else %}Only the Director can publish it.{% endif %}</p>\n     7\t  </div></div>\n     8\t  {% if error and not error_field %}<p class=\"alert-console\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n     9\t  {% set action = path_for('create_report') %}\n    10\t  {% set submit = \"Save draft\" %}\n    11\t  {% set file_label = \"Attach PDF (optional, up to \" ~ max_file_mb ~ \" MB)\" %}\n    12\t  {% include \"admin/_content_fields.html\" %}\n    13\t{% endblock %}\n=================== admin/_content_fields.html\n     1\t{#- A refused save's message, beside the field it is about (error_field), and\n     2\t    the field marked invalid and described by it. Any other refusal is shown\n     3\t    above the form by the page. #}\n     4\t{%- macro invalid(name, hint=\"\") %}\n     5\t  {%- set refused = error_field == name %}\n     6\t  {%- if hint or refused %} aria-describedby=\"{{ hint }}{% if hint and refused %} {% endif %}{% if refused %}{{ name }}-error{% endif %}\"{% endif %}\n     7\t  {%- if refused %} aria-invalid=\"true\"{% endif %}{% endmacro %}\n     8\t{%- macro field_error(name) %}{% if error_field == name %}\n     9\t      <small id=\"{{ name }}-error\" class=\"admin-field-error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</small>{% endif %}{% endmacro %}\n    10\t  <form class=\"admin-content-editing\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\"{% if file_label %} enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"{% endif %}>\n    11\t    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    12\t    {%- if form.item_base %}\n    13\t    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"item_base\" value=\"{{ form.item_base }}\">\n    14\t    {%- endif %}\n    15\t    <div class=\"admin-content-fields\">\n    16\t    <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"title\">Title</label><input type=\"text\" id=\"title\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required{{ invalid(\"title\") }}>\n    17\t      {{- field_error(\"title\") }}</p>\n    18\t    {#- The Summary (spec #22): plain text, counted as the server counts it,\n    19\t        its runs of whitespace as one space, by character. Over the limit,\n    20\t        the count says so; the server refuses it, by this field. #}\n    21\t    <p class=\"field-console admin-summary-field\" data-summary-max=\"{{ summary_max }}\"><label for=\"summary\">Summary (optional)</label>\n    22\t      <textarea id=\"summary\" name=\"summary\" rows=\"2\" cols=\"60\"{{ invalid(\"summary\", \"summary-hint\") }}>{{ form.summary }}</textarea>\n    23\t      <small id=\"summary-hint\" class=\"field-console-hint\">One or two sentences, shown under the title, in lists, and in link previews. Up to {{ summary_max }} characters.\n    24\t        <span class=\"admin-summary-count\" aria-live=\"polite\"></span></small>\n    25\t      {{- field_error(\"summary\") }}</p>\n    26\t    <script>\n    27\t      (() => {\n    28\t        const field = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n    29\t        const max = Number(field.dataset.summaryMax);\n    30\t        const input = field.querySelector(\"textarea\"), count = field.querySelector(\".admin-summary-count\");\n    31\t        const show = () => {\n    32\t          const length = [...input.value.trim().split(/\\s+/).join(\" \")].length;\n    33\t          count.textContent = length > max ? `${length} of ${max}: ${length - max} too many.`\n    34\t                                           : `${length} of ${max}.`;\n    35\t          field.classList.toggle(\"admin-summary-over\", length > max);\n    36\t        };\n    37\t        input.addEventListener(\"input\", show);\n    38\t        show();\n    39\t      })();\n    40\t    </script>\n    41\t    <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"slug\">Slug</label><input type=\"text\" id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n    42\t      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\"{{ invalid(\"slug\", \"slug-hint\") }}>\n    43\t      <small id=\"slug-hint\" class=\"field-console-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small>\n    44\t      {{- field_error(\"slug\") }}</p>\n    45\t    {#- The Editor (app.editor, static/editor.js) takes over the textarea, and\n    46\t        shows the body from the template below, which a browser never renders\n    47\t        itself. If its script doesn't run, the textarea posts Markdown, each\n    48\t        part the Editor can't edit standing as its locked-<n> line. An edit\n    49\t        page lists the item's chart images for \"Insert image\"; a create page\n    50\t        has no item to hold any yet, and lists none. #}\n    51\t    <div class=\"admin-editor\" data-body-dirty=\"{{ 1 if form.body_dirty else 0 }}\"\n    52\t      data-site-items='{{ site_items | tojson }}' data-link-states='{{ link_states | tojson }}'\n    53\t      {%- if body_images is defined %} data-images='{{ body_images | tojson }}'{% endif %}\n    54\t      data-chart-preview=\"{{ path_for('preview_chart') }}\">\n    55\t    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\" required{{ invalid(\"body\") }}>{{ form.body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    56\t    <template class=\"admin-editor-content\">{{ editor_html }}</template>\n    57\t    </div>\n    58\t    {#- Outside the Editor, which replaces the textarea's paragraph. #}\n    59\t    {%- if error_field == \"body\" %}<p>{{ field_error(\"body\") }}</p>{% endif %}\n    60\t    {% if file_label %}\n    61\t    <p><label>{{ file_label }}\n    62\t      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\"{{ invalid(\"file\") }}></label>\n    63\t      {{- field_error(\"file\") }}</p>\n    64\t    {% endif %}\n    65\t    <p class=\"actions-form\"><button class=\"button-primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    66\t    </div>\n    67\t    {#- After the save button, so Enter in a field still saves: the form's\n    68\t        first submit button is the one Enter presses. #}\n    69\t    {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n    70\t  </form>\n    71\t  <script src=\"{{ path_for('editor_script') }}\" defer></script>\n=================== admin/_site_preview.html\n     1\t{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n     2\t   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n     3\t   form, the frame follows the title, Summary, and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n     4\t   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n     5\t   item as saved. #}\n     6\t  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n     7\t    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n     8\t    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n     9\t      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n    10\t      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n    11\t      {%- if preview_path %}\n    12\t      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n    13\t      {%- endif %}\n    14\t      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    15\t    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n    16\t        scroll position across updates. #}\n    17\t    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n    18\t  </section>\n    19\t  <script>\n    20\t    (() => {\n    21\t      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n    22\t      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n    23\t      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n    24\t      for (const button of widths) {\n    25\t        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n    26\t          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n    27\t          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n    28\t        });\n    29\t      }\n    30\t\n    31\t      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n    32\t      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n    33\t      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n    34\t      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n    35\t      if (!form || !path) return;\n    36\t      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n    37\t      let timer, latest = 0;\n    38\t      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n    39\t        // The title, the Summary, the body's textarea, or the Editor\n    40\t        // (static/editor.js).\n    41\t        if (![\"title\", \"summary\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)\n    42\t            && !event.target.closest(\".admin-editor-area\")) return;\n    43\t        clearTimeout(timer);\n    44\t        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n    45\t          const request = ++latest;\n    46\t          const data = new FormData();\n    47\t          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"summary\", \"body\", \"body_html\", \"body_dirty\"]) {\n    48\t            const field = form.elements[name];\n    49\t            if (field && !field.disabled) data.append(name, field.value);\n    50\t          }\n    51\t          let html = null;\n    52\t          try {\n    53\t            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n    54\t            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n    55\t            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n If this\n// script doesn't run, the textarea still posts Markdown. With it, the form\n// posts the Editor's HTML as body_html, and body_dirty=1 once the writer has\n// changed the body; the server sanitizes the HTML and turns it into Markdown.\n// So what is cleaned here is for the writer's sake, never the site's safety.\n//\n// A Chart (T17) is a card in the body, its block in data-chart and its\n// drawing from the server. \"Insert chart\" and a card's \"Edit chart\" open the\n// Chart builder, which the server draws and checks as the writer types.\n//\n// A chart image (T18) is one of the item's uploaded pictures, from its admin\n// route. \"Insert image\" puts one in the body with a description, which it\n// requires; clicking one in the body changes its description or removes it.\n(() => {\n  \"use strict\";\n\n  const LINK = /^(https:\\/\\/|mailto:)/i;\n  const LINK_REFUSED = \"A web address must start with https:// or mailto:. \" +\n    'For a Report or Data Bite, choose \"A page on this site\".';\n  const PAGE_NOT_CHOSEN = \"Choose a Report or Data Bite to link to.\";\n  // A link to a Report or Data Bite (app.site_links): stored by reference\n  // and resolved when the site is published.\n  const SITE_LINK = /^(data-bite|report):[0-9a-f]{32}$/;\n  // How the body marks a site link that won't be a link on the site; the\n  // states are app.site_links'.\n  const LINK_MARKS = {draft: \"Not published: will show as plain text\",\n                      deleted: \"Item deleted\", unknown: \"Unknown link\"};\n  // A picture reaches the body only as an uploaded chart image, by \"Insert image\".\n  const PICTURE_REFUSED = \"Pictures can't be pasted or dropped into the body. \" +\n    'Upload the picture under \"Chart images\", then use \"Insert image\".';\n  const PICTURE_DROPPED = \"The pasted text had pictures, which were left out. \" +\n    'Upload a picture under \"Chart images\", then use \"Insert image\".';\n  const IMAGES_AFTER_SAVE = \"Images can be added after the first save. Save this draft, \" +\n    'then upload a chart image under \"Chart images\" on its edit page.';\n  const NO_IMAGES = 'There are no chart images yet. Upload one under \"Chart images\", ' +\n    \"below the form, then insert it here.\";\n  const IMAGE_NOT_CHOSEN = \"Choose an image to insert.\";\n  const DESCRIPTION_NEEDED = \"Describe what the chart shows, for readers who can't see it.\";\n  const LOCKED = \"[data-locked]\";\n  const CHART = \"[data-chart]\";\n  // What the body shows but doesn't edit in place.\n  const SHOWN_ONLY = `${LOCKED}, ${CHART}`;\n  const CARD = \"admin-editor-chart\";\n  // The wrapper each table sits in (app.rendering), so a wide one scrolls.\n  const TABLE_SCROLL = \"content-table-scroll\";\n  // A new table's size: its header row and two more, three columns across.\n  const NEW_TABLE = {rows: 3, columns: 3};\n  // The Editor's blocks, and the headings pasted ones become: the title is\n  // the page's only H1, and there is nothing below a Subsection.\n  const HEADINGS = {H1: \"h2\", H2: \"h2\", H3: \"h3\", H4: \"h3\", H5: \"h3\", H6: \"h3\"};\n  const SKIPPED = new Set([\"SCRIPT\", area.append(template.content.cloneNode(true));\n    for (const block of area.querySelectorAll(LOCKED)) lock(block);\n    for (const card of area.querySelectorAll(CHART)) chartCard(card);\n templates\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/reports\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n_MAX_FILE_MB = uploads.MAX_BYTES // uploads.MIB\n_MAX_IMAGE_MB = chart_images.MAX_BYTES // chart_images.MIB\ndef _site_preview(request: Request, form: Mapping[str, str], report: sqlite3.Row | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to `report` (None for a new\n    Report), as HTML, served from the preview's copy of the site.\"\"\"\n    at = (request.app.url_path_for(\"report_preview_site\", report_id=report[\"id\"], path=\"\")\n          if report is not None else request.app.url_path_for(\"new_report_preview_site\", path=\"\"))\n    return public_site.report_preview(form, report).render_preview(str(at))\ndef _images(request: Request, report_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    return editing.image_links(request, \"serve_image\", report_id=report_id)\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_reports(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 status: str = Depends(listing.status_filter)):\n    return listing.list_page(request, user, listing.REPORT, status, \"admin/reports.html\")\ndef _new_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: ContentError | None = None,\n              form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    \"\"\"The create form, on its own page; again, with what was typed, after a\n    refused create (a chosen file is not kept).\"\"\"\n    form = form or {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"\", \"summary\": \"\", \"body\": \"\"}\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], \"\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/report_new.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"New Report\", \"user\": user,\n         **editing.error_for(error), \"form\": form, \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, None),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_new_report\")},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_report(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                  file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        report_id = reports.create(title, slug, editor.saved_body(posted, None, None),\n                                   user[\"id\"], summary=summary, pdf=pdf)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _new_page(request, user, error=exc, status_code=400,\n                         form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, \"\", None, None,\n                                                summary=summary))\n    confirm(request, \"Report created as a Draft, with its attached file.\" if pdf\n            else \"Report created as a Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=report_id),\n                            status_code=303)\n# The create page and a new Report's Site preview. Before the /{report_id}\n# routes, which would otherwise take \"new\" or \"preview\" for an id.\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_report_form(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _new_page(request, user)\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_report(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                       posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing; a file chosen in the form is not read.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(\n        request, {\"title\": title, \"summary\": summary, \"body\": shown}, None))\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_report_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Report has no chart images or file (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, report: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: ContentError | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(report)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"])\n    links, names = _images(request, report[\"id\"]), list(reports.images(report[\"id\"]))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/report_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"user\": user,\n         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS, **editing.error_for(error), \"form\": form,\n         \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"], links.src),\n         \"images\": names,\n         \"body_images\": editing.body_images(links, names),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, report),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_report\", report_id=report[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\ndef _get_or_404(report_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    report = reports.get(report_id)\n    if report is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return report\ndef _editable_or_403(report_id: int, user: sqlite3.Row) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"The Report, if `user` may change it. Checked before anything sent is\n    looked at, so a locked Report is 403 whatever was sent. The write checks\n    again, in its UPDATE, in case the Report is published in between; that\n    raises ReportLocked, which the routes also turn into a 403.\"\"\"\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    if not reports.can_edit(report, user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=reports.LOCKED)\n    return report\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}\")\ndef edit_report_form(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id))\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                item_base: str = Form(\"\"), file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    image_name = _images(request, report_id).name\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        if not reports.update(report_id, title, slug,\n                              editor.saved_edit(posted, report, item_base, image_name),\n                              user=user, summary=summary, pdf=pdf,\n                              base=item_base or None):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        # Shown over the Report as stored now, which a stale form missed.\n        current = _get_or_404(report_id)\n        return _edit_page(request, user, current, error=exc,\n saved.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/file\")\ndef download_file(report_id: int):\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    path = reports.file_path(report_id)\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None or not path.is_file():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return FileResponse(path, \"nosniff\"})\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/file/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef remove_file(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    try:\n        if not reports.remove_file(report_id, user=user):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    confirm(request, \"Attached file removed.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                   title: str = Form(\"\"), summary: str = Form(\"\"),\n                   posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The edit form's Site preview, of its unsaved title and body, for its\n    frame and \"Preview on site\". Only for a user who may make those edits\n    (the lockdown). Saves nothing; a file chosen in the form is not read.\"\"\"\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, report[\"body\"],\n                      _images(request, report_id).name)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(\n        request, {\"title\": title, \"summary\": summary, \"body\": shown}, report))\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef report_preview_site(request: Request, report_id: int, path: str):\n    \"\"\"The Site preview's copy of the site: its stylesheet and the Report's\n    chart images and file, draft or not, which any signed-in user may already\n    download here (app.routes.site_preview). Its own page, which a draft's\n    Site preview links from the nav, is its Site preview as saved.\"\"\"\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    if path ==         pdfs=public_site.report_pdf_file(report))\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/images/{name}\")\ndef serve_image(report_id: int, name: str):\n    path = reports.images(report_id).get(name)\n    if path     1\t\"\"\"What the console's item lists share (spec #25, T22): the Data Bites,\n     2\tReports, and All content pages show one `table-items` table, each row an\n     3\titem's title and Summary, its State, author, last update, and the actions the\n     4\tsigned-in user may take on it; and they filter by State with `?status=`.\"\"\"\n     5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     6\t\n     7\timport sqlite3\n     8\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n     9\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n    10\tfrom types import ModuleType\n    11\tfrom typing import NamedTuple\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Query, Request\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import data_bites, reports\n    16\tfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS\n    17\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    18\tfrom app.users import is_director\n    19\t\n    20\t\n    21\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    22\tclass ContentType:\n    23\t    key: str          # e.g. \"data-bite\", as used in ids and query strings\n    24\t    noun: str         # e.g. \"Data Bite\"\n    25\t    plural: str       # e.g. \"Data Bites\"\n    26\t    module: ModuleType\n    27\t    id_param: str     # its routes' id parameter, e.g. \"bite_id\"\n    28\t    list_route: str   # its admin routes' names, for url_path_for / path_for\n    29\t    edit_route: str\n    30\t    delete_route: str  # the confirm-delete page\n    31\t    director_publishes: bool  # only a Director may publish or unpublish one\n    32\t    can_edit: Callable[[sqlite3.Row, sqlite3.Row], bool]  # (item, user): else read-only\n    33\t\n    34\t\n    35\tDATA_BITE = ContentType(\"data-bite\", \"Data Bite\", \"Data Bites\", data_bites, \"bite_id\",\n    36\t                        \"list_bites\", \"edit_bite_form\", \"confirm_delete_bite\",\n    37\t                        director_publishes=False, can_edit=lambda item, user: True)\n    38\tREPORT = ContentType(\"report\", \"Report\", \"Reports\", reports, \"report_id\",\n    39\t                     \"list_reports\", \"edit_report_form\", \"confirm_delete_report\",\n    40\t                     director_publishes=True, can_edit=reports.can_edit)\n    41\tCONTENT_TYPES = (DATA_BITE, REPORT)\n    42\t\n    43\t# The State filters, in order: the query value (\"\" for all) and its label.\n    44\tSTATUS_FILTERS = ((\"\", \"All\"), (\"published\", \"Published\"), (\"draft\", \"Drafts\"))\n    45\t\n    46\t\n    47\tdef _one_of(value: str, allowed, name: str) -> str:\n    48\t    if value not in (\"\", *allowed):\n    49\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f\"Unknown {name} filter.\")\n    50\t    return value\n    51\t\n    52\t\n    53\tdef status_filter(status: str = \"\") -> str:\n    54\t    \"\"\"`?status=` as a route dependency: \"\" (all), or a State. 400 for any\n    55\t    other value.\"\"\"\n    56\t    return _one_of(status, STATUS_LABELS, \"status\")\n    57\t\n    58\t\n    59\tdef type_filter(content_type: str = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\")) -> str:\n    60\t    \"\"\"All content's `?type=`: \"\" (all), or a type's key. 400 for any other\n    61\t    value.\"\"\"\n    62\t    return _one_of(content_type, [ctype.key for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES], \"type\")\n    63\t\n    64\t\n    65\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    66\tclass ItemRow:\n    67\t    \"\"\"One row of a list: the item, its type, what the user may do with it,\n    68\t    and where each action goes, from the routes.\"\"\"\n    69\t    ctype: ContentType\n    70\t    item: sqlite3.Row\n    71\t    may_edit: bool             # else its page is read-only for the user (\"View\")\n    72\t    edit_path: str\n    73\t    status_path: str | None    # publish a draft, or unpublish; None if not the user's to do.\n    74\t                               # It returns to the list filtered as it was.\n    75\t    delete_path: str | None    # Director only\n    76\t\n    77\t\n    78\tdef item_row(request: Request, ctype: ContentType, item: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row,\n    79\t             *, back_status: str = \"\") -> ItemRow:\n    80\t    \"\"\"`item`'s row for `user`. `back_status` is the list's State filter, which\n    81\t    Publish and Unpublish return to.\"\"\"\n    82\t    def path(route: str) -> str:\n    83\t        # The publish and unpublish routes share their names across the types;\n    84\t        # the id parameter picks the type's.\n    85\t        return str(request.app.url_path_for(route, **{ctype.id_param: item[\"id\"]}))\n    86\t\n    87\t    director = is_director(user)\n    88\t    may_publish = director or not ctype.director_publishes\n    89\t    action = \"unpublish\" if item[\"status\"] == \"published\" else \"publish\"\n    90\t    back = f\"?status={back_status}\" if back_status else \"\"\n    91\t    return ItemRow(ctype, item, may_edit=ctype.can_edit(item, user),\n    92\t                   edit_path=path(ctype.edit_route),\n    93\t                   status_path=path(action) + back if may_publish else None,\n    94\t                   delete_path=path(ctype.delete_route) if director else None)\n    95\t\n    96\t\n    97\tclass StateFilter(NamedTuple):\n    98\t    href: str\n    99\t    label: str\n   100\t    count: int     # how many items it shows\n   101\t    current: bool  # the one shown\n   102\t\n   103\t\n   104\tdef filters(path: str, counts: dict[str, int], chosen: str) -> list[StateFilter]:\n   105\t    \"\"\"The State filters for the list at `path`.\"\"\"\n   106\t    return [StateFilter(f\"{path}?status={value}\" if value else path, label,\n   107\t                        counts[value] if value else sum(counts.values()), value == chosen)\n   108\t            for value, label in STATUS_FILTERS]\n   109\t\n   110\t\n   111\tdef list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, ctype: ContentType, status: str,\n   112\t              template: str):\n   113\t    \"\"\"A type's own list, `template`, narrowed to `status` (\"\" for all).\"\"\"\n   114\t    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n   115\t        request, template,\n   116\t        {\"title\": ctype.plural, \"user\": user, \"ctype\": ctype,\n   117\t         \"rows\": [item_row(request, ctype, item, user, back_status=status)\n   118\t                  for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)],\n   119\t         \"filters\": filters(request.url.path, ctype.module.count_by_status(), status),\n   120\t         \"status\": status, \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n   121\t    )\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <div class=\"head-page\"><div>\n    <span class=\"head-page-crumbs text-label\"><a href=\"{{ back }}\">All {{ noun This can't be undone.</p>\n  </div></div>\n  <section class=\"section-console\" aria-labelledby=\"linked-title\">\n    <div class=\"head-section\"><span class=\"text-mono\">01</span><h2 id=\"linked-title\">What links to it</h2></div>\n    {% if linked_from %}\n    <p>These link to it. Once it is deleted, each of those links shows as plain text:</p>\n    <ul class=\"list-console\">\n      {% for found in linked_from %}\n      <li><span class=\"text-label text-muted\">{{ found.noun }}</span> <a href=\"{{ path_for('edit_bite_form', bite_id=found.id) if found.kind == 'data-bite' else path_for('edit_report_form', report_id=found.id) }}\">{{ found.title }}</a></li>\n      {% endfor The two type lists\nfilter by state with `?status=`. Creating an item has its own page, and a\ncreate lands on the new item's edit page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT\n\nLISTS = {\"data-bites\": (\"data-bite\", BITE), \"reports\": (\"report\", REPORT)}\n\n\ndef create(c: TestClient, kind: str, slug: str, **fields) -> str:\n    _, item = LISTS[kind]\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {**item, \"slug\": slug, \"title\": slug.title(),\n                                               **fields})\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return list[str]:\n    return re.findall(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-(\\d+)\"', html)\n\n\ndef row(html: str, key: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<tr id=\"{key}-{item_id}\" role=\"row\">(.*?)</tr>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"{key}-{item_id} is not listed\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef filters(html: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, bool]]:\n    \"\"\"The filter links as (href, label, count, current).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'<nav class=\"filters-console\" aria-label=\"Filter by state\">(.*?)</nav>',\n                      html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no state filters\"\n    return [(href, label, count, bool(current)) for href, current, label, count in re.findall(\n        r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"( aria-current=\"page\")?>([^<]+)<span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d+)</span></a>',\n        match.group(1))]\n\n\n# --- The table ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", LISTS)\ndef summary=\"Headcount on the census date.\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:  # setup: a known update time\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {kind.replace('-', '_')} SET updated_at = '2026-09-30 Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A logged-in client for a second, named Analyst (not the seeded one).\"\"\"\n    account = {\"name\": \"Riley Intern\", \"email\": \"riley@example.test\",\n               \"password\": \"[REDACTED]\", \"role\": \"editor\"}\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/users\", account).status_code == 303\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n    c.post(\"/login\", data={**account, \"csrf_token\": token})\n    return c\n\n\ndef stored_id(table: str, slug: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The id of the item stored in `table` with `slug`. The admin lists show\n    titles, not slugs (T22), so tests find an item's row by its id.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE slug = ?\", (slug,)).fetchone()\n    assert row, f\"no {table} item has the slug {slug}\"\n    return str(row[0])\n\n\ndef stored_slugs(table: str) -> set[str]:\n    \"\"\"Every slug stored in `table`: whether a refused save left an item\n    behind, which the admin lists, showing titles, no longer say (T22).\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return {row[0] for row in conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {table}\")}\n\n\ndef backdate(table: str, row_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Setup only: move a content row's timestamps into the past, so an edit\n    made within the same second still visibly changes updated_at.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET created_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00',\"\n                     \" updated_at = '2026-01-05 09:00:00' WHERE id = ?\", (row_id,))\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef seeded_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Every test gets its own database holding the DEMO_USERS, and its own\n    uploads directory. No deployed URL either, whatever a local .env says; a\n    test that needs one sets it.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", tmp_path / \"uploads\")\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n    db.init_db()\n    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client() -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as():\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        form = c.get(\"/login\")\n        if form.status_code == 404:\n            pytest.skip(\"No /login route yet — build the login ticket first.\")\n        response = c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": user[\"email\"],\n                                          \"password\": user[\"password\"],\n                                          \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(form.text)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\ntests/test_t13_editor_routes.py:82:def {"parentUuid":"be28f195-3e6d-4a3d-94be-c3cc33df6fe2","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f905184a-e02c-47d0-a17e-a6b08ae48d4f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DwJSwPhYE41ePvDxi3CoFf","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T13: the Editor on the Data Bite and Report edit and create pages (issue\n#16): the base version, untouched bodies, locked blocks, and the Markdown\nfallback, through the routes.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, users\nfrom app.content import StaleItem, item_base\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t06_admin_console import site_preview_page\nfrom tests.test_t09_tables import content_body\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor import HOSTILE, LOCKED_BODY\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, data_bites, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, reports, id=\"report\")]\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\ndef stored(module, item_id: str):\n    return module.get(int(item_id))\n\n\ndef edit_page(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> str:\n    response = c.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    return response.text\n\n\ndef field(page: str, name: str) -> str:\n    [value] = re.findall(rf'<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"{name}\" value=\"([^\"]*)\">', page)\n    return unescape(value)\n\n\ndef textarea(page: str) -> str:\n    [value] = re.findall(r'<textarea name=\"body\"[^>]*>(.*?)</textarea>', page, re.S)\n    return unescape(value)\n\n\ndef editor_content(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Editor's HTML, which its script loads into the editable area.\"\"\"\n    [value] = re.findall(r'<template class=\"admin-editor-content\">(.*?)</template>', page, re.S)\n    return value\n\n\ndef save(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str, page: str, **form):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form as the Editor does, from `page` as opened: its base\n    version, and the Editor's HTML untouched unless `form` says otherwise.\"\"\"\n    data = {\"title\": re.search(r'name=\"title\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n            \"slug\": re.search(r'name=\"slug\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n            \"body\": textarea(page), \"item_base\": field(page, \"item_base\"),\n            \"body_html\": editor_content(page), \"body_dirty\": \"0\",\n            \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(page), **form}\n    return c.post(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", data=data,  return unescape(value)\n\n\ndef editor_content(page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Editor's HTML, which its script loads into the editable area.\"\"\"\n    [value] = re.findall(r'<template {"parentUuid":"627b964b-c8d3-4ba3-ad95-9605ef1afc8f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfcLBphuZmiQwAoV5aX23","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VXtbZ7hinCwWKCoTLLL3fa","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t23_edit_pages.py","content":"\"\"\"T23: Edit pages (issue #28, spec #25).\n\nA Data Bite's or Report's edit page is two columns: the fields and the\nEditor, then a Report's PDF and the chart images, beside a sticky Site\npreview. A save bar pinned to the bottom holds the State badge, an \"Unsaved\nchanges\" marker, and Save, Publish or Unpublish, and Delete, each only where\nthe user may do it, and each posting with its CSRF token. A Report locked\nfor an Analyst keeps its read-only view.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import STALE, save\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, id=\"report\")]\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef save_bar(page: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<div class=\"bar-save\" role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Save\">(.*?)</div></div>',\n                      page, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no save bar\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef form_with_id(page: str, form_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<form id=\"{form_id}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</form>', page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no form #{form_id}\"\n    return match.group(0)\n\n\ndef bar_buttons(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"The save bar's actions: each button or link's text, and what it does\n    (the form it posts, or where it leads).\"\"\"\n    bar = save_bar(page)\n    actions = {}\n    for attributes, label in re.findall(r\"<button ([^>]*)>([^<]+)</button>\", bar):\n        owner = re.search(r'form=\"([^\"]+)\"', attributes)\n        actions[label] = form_with_id(page, owner[1]) if owner else None\n    for form in re.findall(r\"<form [^>]*>.*?</form>\", bar, re.S):\n        actions[re.search(r\">([^<]+)</button>\", form)[1]] = form\n    for href, label in re.findall(r'<a class=\"[^\"]*\" href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a>', bar):\n        actions[label] = href\n    return actions\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\n# --- The layout --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_fields_and_editor_sit_beside_the_site_preview(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{create(director)}\").text\n    grid = page[page.index('<div class=\"grid-edit\">'):]\n    form_at = grid.index('<form id=\"form-item\"')\n    preview_at = grid.index('<section class=\"admin-site-preview preview-console\"')\n    assert form_at < grid.index('class=\"admin-editor\"') < preview_at\n    assert 'class=\"field-console field-console-title\"' in page\n    # The slug as the item's address on the site.\n    folder = \"data-bites\" if kind == \"data-bites\" else \"reports\"\n    assert re.search(rf'<div class=\"field-console-slug\"><span>{folder}/</span><input type=\"text\" '\n                     r'id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*><span>\\.html</span></div>', page)\n    assert '<label for=\"slug\">Address</label>' in page\n\n\ndef test_a_reports_pdf_and_chart_images_sit_below_the_editor(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{create_report(director)}\").text\n    editor = page.index('class=\"admin-editor\"')\n    assert editor < page.index('type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf')\n    assert editor < page.index('<section class=\"content-images\"') < page.index(\n        '<section class=\"admin-site-preview')\n\n\n# --- The save bar ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_every_save_bar_action_posts_with_its_csrf_token(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\").text\n    actions = bar_buttons(page)\n    assert set(actions) == {\"Save changes\", \"Publish\", \"Delete\"}\n    token = csrf_from(page)\n    for label in (\"Save changes\", \"Publish\"):\n        assert 'method=\"post\"' in actions[label], label\n        assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\"' in actions[label], label\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"' in actions[\"Save changes\"]\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"' in actions[\"Publish\"]\n    # Delete opens the confirmation page, whose form posts with the token.\n    assert actions[\"Delete\"] == f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\"\n    confirm = director.get(actions[\"Delete\"]).text\n    assert re.search(rf'<form class=\"actions-form\" method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\">'\n                     rf'\\s*<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\">', confirm)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_publish_and_unpublish_from_the_save_bar_return_to_the_edit_page(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    for label, state in ((\"Publish\", \"Published\"), (\"Unpublish\", \"Draft\")):\n        form = bar_buttons(director.get(edit).text)[label]\n        action = re.search(r'action=\"([^\"]+)\"', form)[1]\n        fields = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"([^\"]+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\">', form))\n        response = director.post(action, data=fields, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == edit\n        bar = save_bar(director.get(edit).text)\n        assert f'<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{state.lower()}\">{state}</span>' in bar\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_save_bar_action_without_its_token_is_refused(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    for path in (f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"):\n        response = post_form(director, path, {\"title\": \"No token\"}, with_csrf=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 403, path\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_save_from_the_save_bar_still_refuses_a_stale_form(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    tab_a, tab_b = director.get(edit).text, director.get(edit).text\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, tab_b, title=\"Saved in tab B\").status_code == 303\n    response = save(director, kind, item_id, tab_a, title=\"Saved in tab A\")\n    assert response.status_code == 409 and STALE in response.text\n    # The refusal keeps the save bar, and its unsaved work is marked as such.\n    assert \"Save changes\" in bar_buttons(response.text)\n\n\ndef test_save_is_the_forms_first_submit_button_so_enter_saves(client_as):\n    \"\"\"The save bar sits after the fields but before the Site preview, whose\n    \"Open\" also submits the item's form: the first submit button in the page\n    that belongs to a form is the one Enter presses.\"\"\"\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{create_bite(director)}\").text\n    owned = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'<button [^>]*type=\"submit\"[^>]*form=\"form-item\"'\n                                            r'|<button [^>]*form=\"form-item\"[^>]*type=\"submit\"', page)]\n    assert owned and page.index(\">Save changes</button>\") < page.index(\"Open\")\n    assert page.rfind(\"<button\", 0, Edit pages (issue #28, spec #25).\n\nA Data Bite's or Report's edit page is two columns: the fields and the\nEditor, then a Report's PDF and the chart images, beside a sticky Site\npreview. A save bar pinned to the bottom holds the State badge, an \"Unsaved\nchanges\" marker, and Save, Publish or Unpublish, and Delete, each only where\nthe user may do it, and each posting with its CSRF token. A Report locked\nfor an Analyst keeps its read-only view.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import STALE, save\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", create_bite, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", create_report, id=\"report\")]\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef save_bar(page: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(r'<div class=\"bar-save\" role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Save\">(.*?)</div></div>',\n                      page, re.S)\n    assert match, \"no save bar\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef form_with_id(page: str, form_id: str) -> str:\n    match = re.search(rf'<form id=\"{form_id}\"[^>]*>(.*?)</form>', page, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no form #{form_id}\"\n    return match.group(0)\n\n\ndef bar_buttons(page: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"The save bar's actions: each button or link's text, and what it does\n    (the form it posts, or where it leads).\"\"\"\n    bar = save_bar(page)\n    actions = {}\n    for attributes, label in re.findall(r\"<button ([^>]*)>([^<]+)</button>\", bar):\n        owner = re.search(r'form=\"([^\"]+)\"', attributes)\n        actions[label] = form_with_id(page, owner[1]) if owner else None\n    for form in re.findall(r\"<form [^>]*>.*?</form>\", bar, re.S):\n        actions[re.search(r\">([^<]+)</button>\", form)[1]] = form\n    for href, label in re.findall(r'<a class=\"[^\"]*\" href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a>', bar):\n        actions[label] = href\n    return actions\n\n\ndef publish(director: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str) -> None:\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\", {}).status_code == 303\n\n\n# --- The layout --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_the_fields_and_editor_sit_beside_the_site_preview(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{create(director)}\").text\n    grid = page[page.index('<div class=\"grid-edit\">'):]\n    form_at = grid.index('<form id=\"form-item\"')\n    preview_at = grid.index('<section class=\"admin-site-preview preview-console\"')\n    assert form_at < grid.index('class=\"admin-editor\"') < preview_at\n    assert 'class=\"field-console field-console-title\"' in page\n    # The slug as the item's address on the site.\n    folder = \"data-bites\" if kind == \"data-bites\" else \"reports\"\n    assert re.search(rf'<div class=\"field-console-slug\"><span>{folder}/</span><input type=\"text\" '\n                     r'id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*><span>\\.html</span></div>', page)\n    assert '<label for=\"slug\">Address</label>' in page\n\n\ndef test_a_reports_pdf_and_chart_images_sit_below_the_editor(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{create_report(director)}\").text\n    editor = page.index('class=\"admin-editor\"')\n    assert editor < page.index('type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf')\n    assert editor < page.index('<section class=\"content-images\"') < page.index(\n        '<section class=\"admin-site-preview')\n\n\n# --- The save bar ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_every_save_bar_action_posts_with_its_csrf_token(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\").text\n    actions = bar_buttons(page)\n    assert set(actions) == {\"Save changes\", \"Publish\", \"Delete\"}\n    token = csrf_from(page)\n    for label in (\"Save changes\", \"Publish\"):\n        assert 'method=\"post\"' in actions[label], label\n        assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\"' in actions[label], label\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"' in actions[\"Save changes\"]\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"' in actions[\"Publish\"]\n    # Delete opens the confirmation page, whose form posts with the token.\n    assert actions[\"Delete\"] == f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\"\n    confirm = director.get(actions[\"Delete\"]).text\n    assert re.search(rf'<form class=\"actions-form\" method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\">'\n                     rf'\\s*<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\">', confirm)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_publish_and_unpublish_from_the_save_bar_return_to_the_edit_page(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    for label, state in ((\"Publish\", \"Published\"), (\"Unpublish\", \"Draft\")):\n        form = bar_buttons(director.get(edit).text)[label]\n        action = re.search(r'action=\"([^\"]+)\"', form)[1]\n        fields = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"([^\"]+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\">', form))\n        response = director.post(action, data=fields, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == edit\n        bar = save_bar(director.get(edit).text)\n        assert f'<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{state.lower()}\">{state}</span>' in bar\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_save_bar_action_without_its_token_is_refused(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    for path in (f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"):\n        response = post_form(director, path, {\"title\": \"No token\"}, with_csrf=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 403, path\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_save_from_the_save_bar_still_refuses_a_stale_form(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    tab_a, tab_b = director.get(edit).text, director.get(edit).text\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, tab_b, title=\"Saved in tab B\").status_code == 303\n    response = save(director, kind, item_id, tab_a, title=\"Saved in tab A\")\n    assert response.status_code == 409 and STALE in response.text\n    # The refusal keeps the save bar, and its unsaved work is marked as such.\n    assert \"Save changes\" in bar_buttons(response.text)\n\n\ndef test_save_is_the_forms_first_submit_button_so_enter_saves(client_as):\n    \"\"\"The save bar sits after the fields but before the Site preview, whose\n    \"Open\" also submits the item's form: the first submit button in the page\n    that belongs to a form is the one Enter presses.\"\"\"\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{create_bite(director)}\").text\n    owned = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'<button [^>]*type=\"submit\"[^>]*form=\"form-item\"'\n                                            r'|<button [^>]*form=\"form-item\"[^>]*type=\"submit\"', page)]\n    assert owned and page.index(\">Save changes</button>\") < page.index(\"Open\")\n    assert page.rfind(\"<button\", 0, page.index(\">Save changes</button>\")) == owned[0]\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_may_save_and_publish_a_data_bite_but_not_delete_it(client_as):\n    director, analyst = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{create(director)}\").text\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-save-dirty\" hidden>Unsaved changes</span>' in save_bar(page)\n\n\ndef
