grid.index('<form id=\"form-item\"')\n    preview_at = grid.index('<section class=\"admin-site-preview preview-console\"')\n    assert form_at < grid.index('class=\"admin-editor\"') < preview_at\n    assert 'class=\"field-console field-console-title\"' in page\n    # The slug as the item's address on the site.\n    folder = \"data-bites\" if kind == \"data-bites\" else \"reports\"\n    assert re.search(rf'<div class=\"field-console-slug\"><span>{folder}/</span><input type=\"text\" '\n                     r'id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*><span>\\.html</span></div>', page)\n    assert '<label for=\"slug\">Address</label>' in page\n\n\ndef test_a_reports_pdf_and_chart_images_sit_below_the_editor(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/reports/{create_report(director)}\").text\n    editor = page.index('class=\"admin-editor\"')\n    assert editor < page.index('type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf')\n    assert editor < page.index('<section class=\"content-images\"') < page.index(\n        '<section class=\"admin-site-preview')\n\n\n# --- The save bar ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_every_save_bar_action_posts_with_its_csrf_token(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\").text\n    actions = bar_buttons(page)\n    assert set(actions) == {\"Save changes\", \"Publish\", \"Delete\"}\n    token = csrf_from(page)\n    for label in (\"Save changes\", \"Publish\"):\n        assert 'method=\"post\"' in actions[label], label\n        assert f'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\"' in actions[label], label\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"' in actions[\"Save changes\"]\n    assert f'action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"' in actions[\"Publish\"]\n    # Delete opens the confirmation page, whose form posts with the token.\n    assert actions[\"Delete\"] == f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\"\n    confirm = director.get(actions[\"Delete\"]).text\n    assert re.search(rf'<form class=\"actions-form\" method=\"post\" action=\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/delete\">'\n                     rf'\\s*<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{token}\">', confirm)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_publish_and_unpublish_from_the_save_bar_return_to_the_edit_page(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    for label, state in ((\"Publish\", \"Published\"), (\"Unpublish\", \"Draft\")):\n        form = bar_buttons(director.get(edit).text)[label]\n        action = re.search(r'action=\"([^\"]+)\"', form)[1]\n        fields = dict(re.findall(r'<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"([^\"]+)\" value=\"([^\"]*)\">', form))\n        response = director.post(action, data=fields, follow_redirects=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == edit\n        bar = save_bar(director.get(edit).text)\n        assert f'<span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{state.lower()}\">{state}</span>' in bar\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_save_bar_action_without_its_token_is_refused(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    for path in (f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}/publish\"):\n        response = post_form(director, path, {\"title\": \"No token\"}, with_csrf=False)\n        assert response.status_code == 403, path\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, create\", KINDS)\ndef test_save_from_the_save_bar_still_refuses_a_stale_form(client_as, kind, create):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director)\n    edit = f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\"\n    tab_a, tab_b = director.get(edit).text, director.get(edit).text\n    assert save(director, kind, item_id, tab_b, title=\"Saved in tab B\").status_code == 303\n    response = save(director, kind, item_id, tab_a, title=\"Saved in tab A\")\n    assert response.status_code == 409 and STALE in response.text\n    # The refusal keeps the save bar, and its unsaved work is marked as such.\n    assert \"Save changes\" in bar_buttons(response.text)\n\n\ndef test_save_is_the_forms_first_submit_button_so_enter_saves(client_as):\n    \"\"\"The save bar sits after the fields but before the Site preview, whose\n    \"Open\" also submits the item's form: the first submit button in the page\n    that belongs to a form is the one Enter presses.\"\"\"\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = director.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{create_bite(director)}\").text\n    owned = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'<button [^>]*type=\"submit\"[^>]*form=\"form-item\"'\n                                            r'|<button [^>]*form=\"form-item\"[^>]*type=\"submit\"', page)]\n    assert owned and page.index(\">Save changes</button>\") < page.index(\"Open\")\n    assert page.rfind(\"<button\", 0, The save bar's Save comes before the preview's \"Open\",\n    which also submits the form, so it stays the button Enter presses. #}\n<div class=\"grid-edit\">\n  <div class=\"grid-edit-main\">\n  <form id=\"form-item\" class=\"admin-content-editing\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ action }}\"{% if file_label %} enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"{% endif %}>'''\nassert old_open in s; s = s.replace(old_open, new_open)\n\ns = s.replace('''    <div class=\"admin-content-fields\">\n    <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"title\">Title</label>''', '''    <p class=\"field-console field-console-title\"><label for=\"title\">Title</label>''')\n\nold_hint = '''      <small id=\"summary-hint\" class=\"field-console-hint\">One or two sentences, shown under the title, in lists, and in link previews. Up to {{ summary_max }} characters.</span>\n        <span class=\"admin-summary-count text-mono\" aria-live=\"polite\"></span></small>'''\nassert old_hint in s; s = s.replace(old_hint, new_hint)\n\nold_slug = '''    <p class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"slug\">Slug</label><input type=\"text\" id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\"{{ invalid(\"slug\", \"slug-hint\") }}>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\" class=\"field-console-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small>\n      {{- field_error(\"slug\") }}</p>'''\nnew_slug = '''    {#- The slug, as the item's address on the site: `address`, its folder. #}\n    <div class=\"field-console\"><label for=\"slug\">Address</label>\n      <div class=\"field-console-slug\"><span>{{ address }}</span><input type=\"text\" id=\"slug\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\"{{ invalid(\"slug\", \"slug-hint\") }}><span>.html</span></div>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\" class=\"field-console-hint\">Its page on the site. On its edit page, `attached`: the file it has, which\n        \"Remove file\" removes by a form of its own, below this one. #}\n    {%- if file_label %}\n    <div class=\"field-console field-console-file\">\n      {%- if attached is defined %}\n      <p class=\"field-console-label\">Attached file</p>\n      <p class=\"field-console-attached\">{% if attached.name %}<a href=\"{{ attached.href }}\">{{ attached.name }}</a>\n        <button class=\"button-quiet button-danger\" type=\"submit\" form=\"form-file-remove\">Remove file</button>{% else %}None{% endif %}</p>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <label for=\"file\">{{ file_label }}</label>\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\" id=\"file\"{{ invalid(\"file\") }}>\n      {{- field_error(\"file\") }}</div>\n    {%- endif %}\n    {%- if actions is not defined %}\n    <p class=\"actions-form\"><button class=\"button-primary\" type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    {%- endif %}\n  </form>\n  {%- if attached is defined and attached.name %}\n  <form id=\"form-file-remove\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ attached.remove }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n  </form>\n  {%- endif %}\n  {%- if images is defined %}{% include \"admin/_chart_images.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  {%- if actions is defined %}{% include \"admin/_save_bar.html\" %}{% endif %}\n  </div>\n  {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n</div>\n  <script src=\"{{ path_for('editor_script') }}\" defer></script>'''\nassert old_file in s; Needs\n    `item`, and `actions` (app.routes.listing.ItemRow): the user's actions on\n    it, each shown only if theirs to take. Save submits the item's form\n    (#form-item); Publish or Unpublish posts its own, back to this page; Delete\n    opens the confirmation page. Read-only, it shows the State and why. #}\n  <div class=\"bar-save\" role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Save\"><div class=\"bar-save-inner\">\n    <span class=\"bar-save-state\" role=\"status\"><span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{{ item.status }}\">{{ status_labels[item.status] }}</span>\n      {%- if actions.may_edit %}<span class=\"bar-save-dirty\"{% if not form.body_dirty %} hidden{% endif %}>Unsaved changes</span>\n      {%- else %}<span class=\"bar-save-note\">Only the Director can edit, unpublish, or delete a published Report.</span>{% endif %}</span>\n    {%- if actions.delete_path %}\n    <a class=\"button-quiet button-danger\" href=\"{{ actions.delete_path }}\">Delete</a>\n    {%- endif %}\n    {%- if actions.status_path %}\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ actions.status_path }}\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"back\" value=\"item\">\n      <button class=\"button-secondary\" type=\"submit\">{{ \"Unpublish\" if item.status == \"published\" else \"Publish\" }}</button>\n    </form>\n    {%- endif %}\n    {%- if actions.may_edit %}\n    <button class=\"button-primary\" type=\"submit\" form=\"form-item\">Save changes</button>\n    {%- endif %}\n  </div></div>\n  {%- if actions.may_edit %}\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      // \"Unsaved changes\" follows the Editor's own unsaved state, which counts\n      // the body and every field of the form (static/editor.js).\n      const marker = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling.querySelector(\".bar-save-dirty\");\n      document.getElementById(\"form-item\").addEventListener(\"admin-editor-unsaved\", () => {\n        marker.hidden = false;\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n  {%- endif %}\nEOF\ncat > templates/admin/_edit_head.html <<'EOF'\n{#- An edit page's head (spec #25, T23): the item's title, its State, who\n    made it and when, and, once Published, its page on the site. Needs `item`\n    and `actions` (app.routes.listing.ItemRow), and `site_route`, the public\n    route of its page. #}\n{%- macro iso_date(stamp) %}<time datetime=\"{{ stamp | replace(\" \", \"T\") }}\">{{ stamp[:10] }}</time>{% endmacro %}\n  <div class=\"head-page\"><div>\n    <span class=\"head-page-crumbs text-label\"><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Dashboard</a> / <a href=\"{{ path_for(actions.ctype.list_route) }}\">{{ actions.ctype.plural }}</a> / {{ \"Edit\" if actions.may_edit else \"View\" }}</span>\n    <h1>{{ item.title }}</h1>\n    <dl class=\"facts-page text-label\">\n      <div><dt>State</dt><dd><span class=\"badge-state badge-state-{{ item.status }}\">{{ status_labels[item.status] }}</span></dd></div>\n      <div><dt>Created</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\">{{ iso_date(item.created_at) }}</dd></div>\n      <div><dt>By</dt><dd>{{ item.author_name }}</dd></div>\n      <div><dt>Updated</dt><dd class=\"text-mono\">{{ iso_date(item.updated_at) }}</dd></div>\n    </dl>\n  </div>\n  {%- if item.status == \"published\" %}\n  <div class=\"actions-page\"><a class=\"button-quiet\" href=\"{{ path_for(site_route, slug=item.slug) }}\">View on site <span aria-hidden=\"true\">↗</span></a></div>\n  {%- endif %}\n  </div>\n  {%- if error and not error_field %}<p class=\"alert-console\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\nEOF\ngrep -n \"def path_for\\|path_for\" app/templating.py | head","description":"Write save bar and edit head {"parentUuid":"32847f14-ff80-4e1e-a8f2-c5068df7f89c","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"deferred_tools_record","entries":[{"name":"Monitor","description":"Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.\n\nPick by how many notifications you need:\n- **One** (\"tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes\") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q \"Ready in\" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.\n- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** (\"tell me every time an ERROR line appears\") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).\n- **One per occurrence, until a known end** (\"emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes\") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.\n\nYour script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.\n\n  # Each matching log line is an event\n  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered \"ERROR\"\n\n  # Each file change is an event\n  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir\n\n  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment\n  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\n  while true; do\n    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\n    gh api \"repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last\" --jq '.[] | \"\\(.user.login): \\(.body)\"'\n    last=$now; sleep 30\n  done\n\n  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)\n  node watch-for-events.js\n\n  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes\n  prev=\"\"\n  while true; do\n    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)\n    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!=\"pending\") | \"\\(.name): \\(.bucket)\"' <<<\"$s\" | sort)\n    comm -13 <(echo \"$prev\") <(echo \"$cur\")\n    prev=$cur\n    jq -e 'all(.bucket!=\"pending\")' <<<\"$s\" >/dev/null && break\n    sleep 30\n  done\n\n**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For \"tell me when X is ready,\" use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.\n\n**Script quality:**\n- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.\n- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.\n- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.\n- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification (\"errors in deploy.log\" not \"watching logs\").\n- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)\n\n**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to \"still running.\" Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.\n\n  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit\n  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered \"elapsed_steps=\"\n\n  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on\n  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered \"elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM\"\n\nFor poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.\n\n**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means \"the lines you'd act on,\" not \"only good news.\" Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.\n\nStdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.\n\nThe script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.\n**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.\n\n  Monitor({\n    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},\n    description: 'deploy events',\n  })\n\nEach text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.\n\nPrefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.\n\nWhen an event lands that the user would want to act on now — an error appeared, the status they were waiting on flipped — send a PushNotification. Not every event is worth a push; the ones that change what they'd do next are.","input_schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"description":{"description":"Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).","type":"string"},"timeout_ms":{"description":"Kill the monitor after this deadline. not the author\n    edited = {\"title\": \"Factbook 2026 (draft 2)\", \"slug\": \"factbook\",\n              \"body\": \"Now with *diversity* tables.\"}\n    response = post_form(analyst, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", edited)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n\n    page = analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert edited[\"title\"] in page and edited[\"body\"] in page\n    assert \"Created 2026-01-05 09:00:00 by Riley Intern\" in page\n    updated = re.search(r\"Last updated ([\\d:\\- ]+)\", page).group(1)\n    assert updated != \"2026-01-05 09:00:00\"\n\n\ndef test_analyst_cannot_publish_a_report(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n                     \" VALUES ('Old CDS', 'old-cds', 'Body.', 1)\")\n        assert \"file_name\" not in {r[1] for r in conn.execute(\"PRAGMA table_info(reports)\")}\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", old)\n    db.init_db()\n    for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n        users.create_user(user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"], role)\n\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    rid = report_id(analyst, \"old-cds\")\n    assert \"Attached file:\\n    none\" in analyst.get(f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\").text\n    assert post_with_file(analyst, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\",\n                          {\"title\": \"Old CDS\", \"slug\": \"old-cds\", \"body\": \"Body.\"},\n                          pdf()).status_code == 303\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"site\")\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = publish(director)\n    before = dict(stored_row(kind, item_id))\n\n    form = {**item, \"title\": \"Changed\", \"slug\": \"changed\", \"body\": \"Changed\"}\n    assert preview(director, kind, item_id, **form).status_code == 200\n    assert preview(director, kind, **form).status_code == 200\n    if kind == \"reports\":\n        # \"Preview on site\" posts the whole form, a chosen file included.\n        form[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_from(director.get(\"/admin\").text)\n        response = director.post(f\"/admin/reports/{item_id}/preview\", data=form,\n                                 files={\"file\": (\"new.pdf\", PDF, \"application/pdf\")})\n        assert response.status_code == 200 and \"Changed\" in response.text\n\n    assert dict(stored_row(kind, item_id)) == before","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"85fb9d1f-7913-4a1b-b20f-f0bd2efc286a","timestamp":"2026-10-01T22:55:07.679Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")  # {"parentUuid":"40a4e580-342f-400f-a40e-fc46b347886c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f905184a-e02c-47d0-a17e-a6b08ae48d4f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01A4MfePPCgcyom53RtAFCHC","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:47:27.707Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **768/1440 px and dark mode work through a same-origin iframe harness** (T19, 2026-10-01): serve the scratch `cms publish` export plus a harness page with `python -m http.server`, put iframes at 1440/768/390 px side by side scaled with `transform: scale()` (their `innerWidth` stays true, so media queries apply), and force dark by setting each `prefers-color-scheme: dark` CSSMediaRule's `media.mediaText = \"all\"` inside the frame. Print: same trick on `@media print`. Report `document.fonts` statuses and `scrollWidth > innerWidth` in the harness's status line.\n- **Screenshot `scale` also shrinks the saved file**: use scale 1 with `save_to_disk` for anything going in docs/screenshots.\n- **Programmatic `.focus()` in a frame doesn't match `:focus`** (no window focus); press real Tab keys on the page itself (the first Tab lands in browser chrome).\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` passwords set by env, so checks never touch the real `cms.db`.\n- The user has accepted \"not checked\" for Safari and 768/1440 on T15 and T16, recorded on the issue.\n- **Click by element ref, not coordinates**: the screenshot coordinate frame switches between e.g. 1372×872 and 1200×763 within one session, so coordinate clicks miss (T18 typed a description into the body). Use `find` refs.\n- **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. The Editor's own listener sets its \"leaving\" flag, and nothing is posted.\n- **Submitting forms** (T20, 2026-10-01): a ref click on a submit button, and `type` into a header search field, sometimes do nothing. `form_input` to set values plus `form.requestSubmit(button)` from `javascript_tool` works; check the Confirmation afterwards rather than trusting the click. Don't await across the submit's navigation in the same script (it errors \"Inspected target navigated\").\n- **Viewport harness file**: `render_site` wipes its output folder, so write the harness page into the export *after* publishing (T20 kept it at `<scratch>/t20/site/harness.html`, with `?page=&dark=1&h=`). Filter `document.fonts` to `Atkinson*`: the browser adds its own faces (Inter, Super Sans) to the list.\n- **Console pages at 1440/768/390** (T21, 2026-10-01): no export needed. Sign in, open any `/admin` page, and from `javascript_tool` replace its body with three same-origin iframes of the page under test (same dark-mode trick). `fetch('/admin.css', {cache: \"reload\"})` first after a CSS edit. Also test the bar with a **long user name** (set one in the scratch DB with sqlite3): T21's first breakpoint let \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\" squeeze the nav at 900 px, which the short demo names hid.\n- **Measure a contrast claim before writing it**: T21's draft said bright purple failed on the field; it measured 5.35/4.62 and passed.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive a server restart; `fetch(src, {cache: \"reload\"})` then navigate again.\n---\nname: design-taste\ndescription: \"User rejects default/\\\"AI-ey\\\" visual design; what was rejected and what was approved for the public site\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: feedback\n  originSessionId: eae09489-d0ef-4a1c-b220-1610b02a6314\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:22:21.628Z\n---\n\nThe user rejected two mockups before approving one (session 22, 2026-10-01, spec #22):\n- Rejected as \"juvenile and AI-ey\": Inter, purple gradient hero, rounded cards with shadows and coloured top borders, pill nav, uppercase eyebrows everywhere.\n- Rejected as \"everyone uses this\": the newspaper look, meaning a Newsreader-style serif, italic standfirsts, and a masthead nameplate.\n- Approved, \"set like a dataset\": Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono, solid Kenyon-purple fields with a faint plotting grid, one citron accent only on purple, numbered nav and sections, ISO dates, and Reports in a real table. The mockup is in `docs/design/session-22-mockup/`.\n\n- Admin console approved 2026-10-01 as \"same family, calmer\": public fonts and tokens on light paper, the purple field only as a slim top bar, square status badges, a pinned save bar. Mockup in `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/`. The user wants the console \"usable and pretty\", not just restyled: navigation, separate create pages, a dashboard of what needs attention.\n- Citron (neon green) is an accent for the purple field only; the user tried it in Charts (T19, 2026-10-01) and rejected it. Charts stay purples and greys.\n\n**Why:** they want it \"genuinely impressive and out of the box but also readable and a school website\".\n\n**How to apply:** for any visual work here (including the later admin-console redesign), don't start from stock patterns. Pick a concept tied to the office's actual subject and justify the font choice. Build on the approved system, not on defaults. See [[browser-checks-environment]] for how to take the screenshots.\n| The new `invalid()` macro covered title, body, and file, but slug and Summary hand-wrote `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: the macro takes the field's hint, and all five fields use it |\n| `item_row` called `reports.can_edit` directly, and `director_publishes` also decided editing | Feature Envy / Mysterious Name | **Fixed**: `ContentType.can_edit` is the type's rule (`reports.can_edit`, or always for a Data Bite); `director_publishes` now means only publishing |\n| `filters()` returned dicts with string keys | Primitive Obsession | **Fixed**: a `StateFilter` NamedTuple |\n| `.filters-content` (All content's form) beside `.filters-console` (the State tabs) | Mysterious Name | **Fixed**: renamed `.form-content-filter` |\n| \"State\" on the pages, `status` in code | Vocabulary | **Fixed**: **State** is in `CONTEXT.md`, which records that code and `?status=` say `status` |\n| The two `_new_page` functions and the two `/new` templates are near-identical | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** They follow the existing pair of `_edit_page`s, one per type's module. T23 rebuilds both edit pages and is the place to fold create and edit together |\n| `.text-hidden` repeats the visually-hidden recipe in the phone media queries | Duplicated Code | **Kept**, as in T21: the media-query copies apply only at a breakpoint |\n| `STATUS_FILTERS` repeats \"Published\" from `STATUS_LABELS` | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** The filter says \"Drafts\" (plural), so the labels differ |\n| `user.role == \"admin\"` in `reports.html` and `report_new.html` | Repeated Switches | **Kept.** It's the existing template idiom; no template global wraps `is_director` yet |\n\n#### Spec\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| **Stacked rows lose table semantics.** \"Rows stack on a phone. The table keeps its semantics, as in T20's Reports table.\" T20 adds explicit roles because `display: grid` on a `tr` can make some browsers stop reading it as a table | **Fixed** in `f4606b2`: `role=\"table\"`, `rowgroup`, `row`, `columnheader`, `rowheader`, and `cell`, with a test |\n| Publish/Unpublish from a filtered list landed back on All | **Fixed**: the form posts to `…/publish?status=draft`, and the redirect returns to that filter. A bad value is a 400, as on the list. Tested |\n| The `/new` form has a Slug field, not the address field (`data-bites/` [slug] `.html`) | **Deferred to T23**, where spec #25 defines the address field. The create page shares the edit page's fields, so it gets it then |\n| Delete is a link to the confirm page, not a POST | **No change.** As now: the confirm page's Delete posts with its CSRF token |\n| Not asked for: an unknown `?type=` on All content is a 400, not a 422 | **Kept.** Spec #25 says \"a 400, as on the All content page\"; it was a 422. One rule for all three lists. The test change is in `cadfec1`'s message |\n| Not asked for: the edit pages got field-level errors, a red border on a refused field, `field-console` fields, and a solid Save | **Kept.** The create and edit pages share `_content_fields.html`. The ticket asks for \"the error by its field\", which needs the shared fields. T23 lays out the edit page |\n| Not asked for: \"View\" for a Report an Analyst can't edit, and an actions column on Reports for an Analyst | **Kept.** It follows the existing lock rule: the link opens today's read-only page, and an Analyst still gets no Publish or Delete |\n| Not asked for: ledes, per-filter empty messages (\"No Report is Published yet.\"); the mockup's \"Who publishes\" fact became the lede | **Kept.** The page-head pattern from T21 |\n\nTests changed in place, with reasons (also in `cadfec1`'s message):\n- The create redirect now goes to the edit page.\n- The lists show no slugs, so rows are found by stored id (`conftest.stored_id`), and \"nothing was saved\" checks the stored slugs (`conftest.stored_slugs`). Several `slug not in list` checks would otherwise pass vacuously.\n- The create-form tests read `/new`.\n- All content rows are matched in their new markup.\n- `?type=`/`?status=` errors on All content are 400.\n\nThe full suite passes: **1,475 passed**.\n\n### Browser check\n\nA scratch instance (`cms serve` on port 8003 with its own seeded database in the session scratchpad), signed in as the demo Director. The harness is three same-origin iframes at 1440, 768, and 390 px. Dark mode is forced by switching on each frame's `prefers-color-scheme: dark` rules. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n| Check | Result | Screenshot |\n|---|---|---|\n| Data Bites list, light | **Pass.** Atkinson Next and Mono `loaded` at all three widths (italic unused). Body font is \"Atkinson Next\"; no sideways scroll. The table at 1440 and 768. At 390 each row stacks: title and Summary, then badge, author, and date, then actions. Filter counts All 4 / Published 3 / Drafts 1 | `console-data-bites-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Data Bites, Drafts filter, dark | **Pass.** Only the draft row. The first draft showed the current filter's underline in Kenyon purple, nearly invisible on dark paper; it now uses the theme's purple (8.09:1) | `console-data-bites-drafts-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| Reports list, light and dark | **Pass.** As above; Director sees Publish/Unpublish and Delete | `console-reports-1440-768-390-light.jpg`, `console-reports-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| New Data Bite, light | **Pass.** Title, Summary, Slug, Editor, and Save draft; Site preview beside at 1440, below at 768 and 390; no sideways scroll. \"02 Data Bites\" marked current | `console-new-data-bite-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| New Report, dark | **Pass.** As above, plus the PDF field | `console-new-report-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| A refused create (slug `index`), each width | **Pass.** Back on \"New Data Bite\" (400), the typed title kept, the message under Slug, the field `aria-invalid=\"true\"` and `aria-describedby=\"slug-hint slug-error\"`, with a red border | `console-new-data-bite-refused-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| A real create | **Pass.** Landed on `/admin/data-bites/5`, \"Edit Data Bite\", with the Confirmation \"Data Bite created as a Draft.\" | — |\n| All content, light | **Pass.** The same table, each title with its type above it | `console-all-content-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Publish from the Drafts filter | **Pass.** Each row's form posts to `…/publish?status=draft`; every row link is a route's path | — |\n\n**Contrast** (WCAG ratio, light / dark). New pairs only; the rest are in T21's table:\n\n| Pair | Light | Dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| Published badge (purple on tint) | 8.98 | 7.42 |\n| Draft badge, filters, Summaries (muted on paper) | 6.52 | 7.31 |\n| Current filter's underline (purple on paper, non-text) | 9.98 | 8.09 |\n| Row Delete (danger on paper) | 6.29 | 8.37 |\n\n**Not checked:** Safari, Windows High Contrast mode, and an Analyst's lists in the browser. Mockup in `docs/design/admin-console-mockup/`. The user wants the console \"usable and pretty\", not just restyled: navigation, separate create pages, a dashboard of what needs attention.\n- Citron (neon green) is an accent for the purple field only; the user tried it in Charts (T19, 2026-10-01) and rejected it. Charts stay purples and greys.\n\n**Why:** they want it \"genuinely impressive and out of the box but also readable and a school website\".\n\n**How to apply:** for any visual work here (including the later admin-console redesign), don't start from stock patterns. Pick a concept tied to the office's actual subject and justify the font choice. Build on the approved system, not on defaults. See [[browser-checks-environment]] for how to take the screenshots.\n| The new `invalid()` macro covered title, body, and file, but slug and Summary hand-wrote `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` | Duplicated Code | **Fixed**: the macro takes the field's hint, and all five fields use it |\n| `item_row` called `reports.can_edit` directly, and `director_publishes` also decided editing | Feature Envy / Mysterious Name | **Fixed**: `ContentType.can_edit` is the type's rule (`reports.can_edit`, or always for a Data Bite); `director_publishes` now means only publishing |\n| `filters()` returned dicts with string keys | Primitive Obsession | **Fixed**: a `StateFilter` NamedTuple |\n| `.filters-content` (All content's form) beside `.filters-console` (the State tabs) | Mysterious Name | **Fixed**: renamed `.form-content-filter` |\n| \"State\" on the pages, `status` in code | Vocabulary | **Fixed**: **State** is in `CONTEXT.md`, which records that code and `?status=` say `status` |\n| The two `_new_page` functions and the two `/new` templates are near-identical | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** They follow the existing pair of `_edit_page`s, one per type's module. T23 rebuilds both edit pages and is the place to fold create and edit together |\n| `.text-hidden` repeats the visually-hidden recipe in the phone media queries | Duplicated Code | **Kept**, as in T21: the media-query copies apply only at a breakpoint |\n| `STATUS_FILTERS` repeats \"Published\" from `STATUS_LABELS` | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** The filter says \"Drafts\" (plural), so the labels differ |\n| `user.role == \"admin\"` in `reports.html` and `report_new.html` | Repeated Switches | **Kept.** It's the existing template idiom; no template global wraps `is_director` yet |\n\n#### Spec\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| **Stacked rows lose table semantics.** \"Rows stack on a phone. The table keeps its semantics, as in T20's Reports table.\" T20 adds explicit roles because `display: grid` on a `tr` can make some browsers stop reading it as a table | **Fixed** in `f4606b2`: `role=\"table\"`, `rowgroup`, `row`, `columnheader`, `rowheader`, and `cell`, with a test |\n| Publish/Unpublish from a filtered list landed back on All | **Fixed**: the form posts to `…/publish?status=draft`, and the redirect returns to that filter. A bad value is a 400, as on the list. Tested |\n| The `/new` form has a Slug field, not the address field (`data-bites/` [slug] `.html`) | **Deferred to T23**, where spec #25 defines the address field. The create page shares the edit page's fields, so it gets it then |\n| Delete is a link to the confirm page, not a POST | **No change.** As now: the confirm page's Delete posts with its CSRF token |\n| Not asked for: an unknown `?type=` on All content is a 400, not a 422 | **Kept.** Spec #25 says \"a 400, as on the All content page\"; it was a 422. One rule for all three lists. The test change is in `cadfec1`'s message |\n| Not asked for: the edit pages got field-level errors, a red border on a refused field, `field-console` fields, and a solid Save | **Kept.** The create and edit pages share `_content_fields.html`. The ticket asks for \"the error by its field\", which needs the shared fields. T23 lays out the edit page |\n| Not asked for: \"View\" for a Report an Analyst can't edit, and an actions column on Reports for an Analyst | **Kept.** It follows the existing lock rule: the link opens today's read-only page, and an Analyst still gets no Publish or Delete |\n| Not asked for: ledes, per-filter empty messages (\"No Report is Published yet.\"); the mockup's \"Who publishes\" fact became the lede | **Kept.** The page-head pattern from T21 |\n\nTests changed in place, with reasons (also in `cadfec1`'s message):\n- The create redirect now goes to the edit page.\n- The lists show no slugs, so rows are found by stored id (`conftest.stored_id`), and \"nothing was saved\" checks the stored slugs (`conftest.stored_slugs`). Several `slug not in list` checks would otherwise pass vacuously.\n- The create-form tests read `/new`.\n- All content rows are matched in their new markup.\n- `?type=`/`?status=` errors on All content are 400.\n\nThe full suite passes: **1,475 passed**.\n\n### Browser check\n\nA scratch instance (`cms serve` on port 8003 with its own seeded database in the session scratchpad), signed in as the demo Director. The harness is three same-origin iframes at 1440, 768, and 390 px. Dark mode is forced by switching on each frame's `prefers-color-scheme: dark` rules. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n| Check | Result | Screenshot |\n|---|---|---|\n| Data Bites list, light | **Pass.** Atkinson Next and Mono `loaded` at all three widths (italic unused). Body font is \"Atkinson Next\"; no sideways scroll. The table at 1440 and 768. At 390 each row stacks: title and Summary, then badge, author, and date, then actions. Filter counts All 4 / Published 3 / Drafts 1 | `console-data-bites-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Data Bites, Drafts filter, dark | **Pass.** Only the draft row. The first draft showed the current filter's underline in Kenyon purple, nearly invisible on dark paper; it now uses the theme's purple (8.09:1) | `console-data-bites-drafts-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| Reports list, light and dark | **Pass.** As above; Director sees Publish/Unpublish and Delete | `console-reports-1440-768-390-light.jpg`, `console-reports-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| New Data Bite, light | **Pass.** Title, Summary, Slug, Editor, and Save draft; Site preview beside at 1440, below at 768 and 390; no sideways scroll. \"02 Data Bites\" marked current | `console-new-data-bite-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| New Report, dark | **Pass.** As above, plus the PDF field | `console-new-report-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| A refused create (slug `index`), each width | **Pass.** Back on \"New Data Bite\" (400), the typed title kept, the message under Slug, the field `aria-invalid=\"true\"` and `aria-describedby=\"slug-hint slug-error\"`, with a red border | `console-new-data-bite-refused-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| A real create | **Pass.** Landed on `/admin/data-bites/5`, \"Edit Data Bite\", with the Confirmation \"Data Bite created as a Draft.\" | — |\n| All content, light | **Pass.** The same table, each title with its type above it | `console-all-content-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| Publish from the Drafts filter | **Pass.** Each row's form posts to `…/publish?status=draft`; every row link is a route's path | — |\n\n**Contrast** (WCAG ratio, light / dark). New pairs only; the rest are in T21's table:\n\n| Pair | Light | Dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| Published badge (purple on tint) | 8.98 | 7.42 |\n| Draft badge, filters, Summaries (muted on paper) | 6.52 | 7.31 |\n| Current filter's underline (purple on paper, non-text) | 9.98 | 8.09 |\n| Row Delete (danger on paper) | 6.29 | 8.37 |\n\n**Not checked:** Safari, Windows High Contrast mode, and an Analyst's lists in the browser. {"parentUuid":"77597c1a-1a9c-4f10-b4b6-e2a1cb639b6e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f905184a-e02c-47d0-a17e-a6b08ae48d4f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review changes since 49c84df (T23, issue #28, spec #25), including uncommitted working-tree changes."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"4f78caa8-e115-484f-a9c2-bda143d663da","timestamp":"2026-10-01T23:06:11.181Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_014pNScbHSgWkWZyNxJNM6BX","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"64357a30-87f1-41b4-b8f9-9b3ad7295b77","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The same hunk already uses `path_for('download_file', …)`, and T22's review moved row links onto the routes for this reason. `action = \"/admin/…\" ~ id` is older code, but it was touched again here.\n  2. **Vocabulary (CLAUDE.md: \"Use the vocabulary in CONTEXT.md. The `.content-body` and `.chart-*` rules are copied into admin.css, not linked. The cost is that the chart-series `:has()` block is now word for word in both site.css (lines 254-260) and admin.css. The ADR accepts that copy, and a documented repo standard overrides the duplication smell, so this is not a finding.\n  4. **CSRF, sanitising, `site/`:** all met. The Publish/Unpublish form in the save bar and `#form-file-remove` carry `csrf_token`, and Delete is a GET to the confirmation page. editor.js only gains the `markUnsaved` / `admin-editor-unsaved` hook, which is the change the spec allows.\n  \n  **Smells (all judgement calls)**\n  \n  - **Duplicated Code / Shotgun Surgery:** `_set_status` got the same `back == \"item\"` branch, and `publish`/`unpublish` the same `back: str = Form(\"\")`, in both data_bites.py and reports.py. One shared helper in `listing` would remove the parallel edit.\n  - **Primitive Obsession:** the bare string `back == \"item\"` decides where the redirect goes.\n  - **Data Clumps / Duplicated Code:**\n    - `{% set address = \"data-bites/\" %}` / `\"reports/\"` is repeated in four templates.\n    - `{% set item, site_route = bite, \"data_bite\" %}` is set in each edit template.\n    - `reports/{{ report.slug }}.html` is hard-coded again in the locked view.\n    - All of these belong on `ContentType`, which `actions.ctype` already gives the templates.\n  - **Duplicated Code (CSS):** `:where(.admin-chart-builder) button {…}` repeats the declarations of `:where(.page-console) button` exactly. A shared `:where(.page-console, .admin-chart-builder)` selector would do.\n  - **Redundant selector:** in `.field-console .field-console-file input[type=\"file\"], .field-console-file input[type=\"file\"]`, the second selector already covers the first.\n  - **Mysterious Name / dead hooks:**\n    - `class=\"admin-content-editing\"` on the form and `admin-site-preview` on the section no longer have any CSS. They survive only as test anchors.\n    - `.grid-edit-main` and `.bar-save-note` have no rules.\n  - **Stale comment:** `ItemRow.status_path` (listing.py) still says \"It returns to the list filtered as it was\", which is no longer always true after the save bar's `back=item`.\n  - **Broad descendant selectors (global CSS rule, minor):** `.facts-page div`, `.facts-item div`, `.field-console-slug span`, `.content-images label/small` reach every nested element of that kind. They are prefixed, so this is low risk.\n  \n  **Class naming:** the new classes (`.grid-edit`, `.bar-save-*`, `.preview-console`, `.toggle-console`, `.facts-*`, `.field-console-*`) follow the existing scoped pattern. I found no bare generic names.\n</agent-message>"}

There are no blocking findings, only three small judgement calls.**\n  \n  I checked it against #28, the #25 \"Shared\", \"T23: Edit pages\" and \"Testing Decisions\" sections, and `edit.html`. The full suite passes: 1495 passed.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  \n  1. Ticket: \"Every save-bar action posts with its CSRF token.\" Save and Publish/Unpublish post with the token. **Delete is a GET link** (`<a href=\"/admin/{kind}/{id}/delete\">`) to the confirmation page, and only that page's form posts with CSRF. This matches how the list rows already work, and `test_every_save_bar_action_posts_with_its_csrf_token` checks it that way. It is a reasonable reading, but it doesn't meet the line literally. Worth a sentence in the closing comment.\n  2. Ticket: \"an 'Unsaved changes' marker that follows the Editor's dirty state and any field's input.\" That is met as written. But after a refused save (400 or 409) where only the title, Summary or slug changed, `body_dirty` is 0. The re-rendered page then starts with the marker hidden while the form holds values that were never saved. Separately, the 409 test's comment says \"its unsaved work is marked as such\", but it only asserts that \"Save changes\" exists. That is a gap in the test, not in the code.\n  3. Spec: \"No action may lose CSRF or the stale-form check (`item_base`).\" Publish/Unpublish in the save bar post without `item_base`, so they act on the saved version and skip any unsaved edits. Nothing is lost silently: editor.js's `beforeunload` warns, because `leaving` is only set when the item's own form submits. Publish never had a stale check, so no check was lost. Still, nothing tests what happens when you publish with unsaved edits.\n  \n  **(b) Scope creep**\n  \n  Nothing significant.\n  - The `back=item` form field on publish/unpublish, which redirects back to the edit page, is needed for the save bar.\n  - The page head (breadcrumbs, State/Created/By/Updated facts, \"View on site ↗\") comes straight from the mockup.\n  - The slug's label changes from \"Slug\" to \"Address\" and its hint is reworded. That follows from the \"address field\" requirement.\n  - The create pages now get the two-column grid and the address field, which fits T22's \"laid out like the edit page\".\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but looks wrong**\n  \n  Nothing found. Verified:\n  - **Layout:** `.grid-edit` has two columns and drops to one at `max-width: 64rem`. `.preview-console` is `position: sticky` and turns static below 64rem.\n  - **Save bar:** `.bar-save` is `position: fixed; bottom: 0`.\n  - **Fields:** the title is large (`font-size: 1.5rem`). The address reads `data-bites/` or `reports/` + slug + `.html`. A Report's PDF and chart images sit under the Editor. The buttons outside the form use `form=\"form-item\"` / `form=\"form-file-remove\"`.\n  - **editor.js:** the only change is `markUnsaved` dispatching `admin-editor-unsaved`. Behaviour is the same as before.\n  - **Chart colours:** Chart cards use the purple/grey tokens, and the old blue/orange hex values are gone.\n  - **Locked Report:** an Analyst sees the read-only view in `grid-edit`, and the save bar shows the badge and note with no actions. A test covers this.\n  - **Stale form:** a stale save is still refused with 409, and a test covers it.\n</agent-message>"}

s = p.read_text()\nold = '''    # The refusal keeps the save bar, and its unsaved work is marked as such.\n    assert \"Save changes\" in bar_buttons(response.text)\n'''\nnew = '''    # The refusal keeps the save bar, and its unsaved title is marked as such.\n    assert \"Save changes\" in bar_buttons(response.text)\n    assert '<span class=\"bar-save-dirty\">Unsaved changes</span>' in save_bar(response.text)\n'''\nassert old in s; {"parentUuid":"315c410d-8211-4e5f-a33e-94492ac9946e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"8597e88e-471c-4a2f-9d37-3f0ed05c690b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017xvRojcnwhJTWqz1eMJUeN","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"63449542-d76e-4a15-be62-623d57168e73","timestamp":"2026-10-01T23:12:24.216Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","oldString":"**Site preview**:","newString":"**Address**:\nWhere a Data Bite's or Report's page is on the site: its type's folder, its\nslug, and `.html` (e.g. `data-bites/fall-enrollment.html`). The edit page\nshows the slug as an Address field, the folder and `.html` either side of it\n(spec #25, T23). In code, and in the form, the part typed is the `slug`.\n_Avoid_: URL, permalink, slug (on a page)\n\n**Site preview**:","originalFile":"# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**State**:\nWhether a Data Bite or Report is a Draft or Published. The Console's lists\nshow it as a badge and filter by it (spec #25, T22). In code and in the\nlists' `?status=`, it is `status`.\n_Avoid_: status (on a page), stage\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Summary**:\nOne or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200\ncharacters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title\non its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's\ndescription and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without\none shows nothing in its place.\n_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb\n\n**Homepage settings**:\nThe homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright\npurple), its intro, and its Key figures. Edited by the Director only, at\n/admin/homepage. Settings, not content: no Draft, and on the public site from\nthe next `cms publish`, like a change to the nav (spec #22, T20).\n_Avoid_: hero, homepage content\n\n**Key figure**:\nOne of up to four numbers on the homepage, each a value, a label saying what\nit counts, and an optional note saying when or of whom (e.g. \"1,805\" /\n\"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Console**:\nThe admin console: the local, signed-in app where the Director and Analysts\nwrite and publish content, never on the public internet. Every page has the\nsame bar: numbered nav (01 Dashboard, 02 Data Bites, 03 Reports, and, for\nthe Director, 04 Homepage and 05 Users), who is signed in, \"View site ↗\",\nand Log out (spec #25, T21). Its home page is the **Dashboard**.\n_Avoid_: back end, dashboard (that is its home page only)\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":90,"oldLines":6,"newStart":90,"newLines":13,"lines":[" shows as plain text (spec #14, T14)."," _Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference"," ","+**Address**:","+Where a Data Bite's or Report's page is on the site: its type's folder, its","+slug, and `.html` (e.g. `data-bites/fall-enrollment.html`). The edit page","+shows the slug as an Address field, the folder and `.html` either side of it","+(spec #25, T23). In code, and in the form, the part typed is the `slug`.","+_Avoid_: URL, permalink, slug (on a page)","+"," **Site preview**:"," A Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the"," site's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"315c410d-8211-4e5f-a33e-94492ac9946e","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"64357a30-87f1-41b4-b8f9-9b3ad7295b77","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The two edit forms' actions now use `path_for('edit_bite' / 'edit_report', …)` too |\n| The slug field's label is now \"Address\", which is not in `CONTEXT.md` | Vocabulary (CLAUDE.md) | **Fixed**: **Address** is in the glossary. It records that the part typed is the `slug` in code |\n| `back == \"item\"` and its redirect were copied into both `_set_status`s | Duplicated Code / Primitive Obsession | **Fixed**: `listing.after_status_change`, with the value named `listing.BACK_TO_ITEM` |\n| The folder (`data-bites/`, `reports/`) and the public route were set by hand in four templates and hard-coded again in the locked view | Data Clumps | **Fixed**: `ContentType.folder` and `ContentType.site_route`. The pages pass `ctype` |\n| `:where(.admin-chart-builder) button {…}` repeated the page's control rules | Duplicated Code (CSS) | **Fixed**: one `:where(.page-console, .admin-chart-builder)` set |\n| A redundant file-input selector, and broad descendant selectors (`.facts-page div`, `.field-console-slug span`, `.content-images label`) | Global CSS rule | **Fixed**: one selector; child combinators, or scoped to the upload form |\n| `ItemRow.status_path`'s comment said it always returns to the list | Stale comment | **Fixed**: it mentions `back=item` |\n| The chart rules are now word for word in both `site.css` and `admin.css` | Duplicated Code | **Kept.** ADR-007 requires the copy: no rule crosses between the two stylesheets |\n| `admin-content-editing`, `admin-site-preview`, `.grid-edit-main`, `.bar-save-note` have no CSS of their own | Mysterious Name | **Kept.** The first two are the hooks the tests and the preview script find the form and section by. The other two name a grid cell and the locked note, as in the mockup |\n\n#### Spec\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| **After a refused save that changed only the title, Summary, or slug, the page came back with the marker hidden**, because `body_dirty` was 0. Its 409 test said \"marked as such\" but didn't assert it | **Fixed.** A page re-shown after a refused save or create carries `data-unsaved=\"1\"` on its form. The marker starts visible, and the Editor counts it as unsaved, so it also warns before the page is left. That is one more line in the marker hook in `editor.js`. Tested for both types, and the 409 test now asserts the marker |\n| \"Every save-bar action posts with its CSRF token\": Delete is a link to the confirmation page | **No change.** As in the lists: the confirmation page's form posts with the token. The test follows the link and checks that form |\n| Publish/Unpublish post without `item_base`, so they act on the saved version | **No change.** Publish never had a stale check. With unsaved edits, the Editor's leave warning fires, since only the item's own form sets \"leaving\". Checked by reading the code, not in the browser: the native dialog would stall the browser automation |\n| Not asked for: `back=item` on Publish/Unpublish; the page head's facts and \"View on site ↗\"; the Address field and grid on the create pages | **Kept.** The save bar needs to return to the page it was used on. The head is the mockup's. The create pages share the fields, and T22 deferred the Address field to here |\n\nTests changed in place, with reasons (also in `30099ed`'s message):\n- The head's facts replace \"Created … by …\" (t03, t04).\n- The attached-file line moved into the form (t05).\n- \"Preview on site\" is now the preview's \"Open\", outside the form it posts (t12).\n- The item's form has an id (t22).\n\nThe full suite passes: **1,497 passed**.\n\n## Browser check\n\nA scratch instance (`cms serve` on port 8004, its own seeded database in the session scratchpad). The harness is three same-origin iframes at 1440, 768, and 390 px. Dark mode is forced by switching on each frame's `prefers-color-scheme: dark` rules. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/`.\n\n| Check | Result | Screenshot |\n|---|---|---|\n| Edit a Data Bite, light, Director | **Pass.** Two columns at 1440, one at 768 and 390. Title large, the Summary count, `data-bites/` [slug] `.html`, the Editor, then Chart images. The Site preview is beside the fields and stays put while they scroll. The marker is on after a typed change. `document.fonts`: Atkinson Next normal and italic, and Mono, all `loaded`; body font \"Atkinson Next\"; no sideways scroll at any width | `console-edit-data-bite-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| The marker, real typing | **Pass.** Typing in the body turned it on. Choosing a PDF turned it on. Save cleared it, with \"Data Bite saved.\" | — |\n| Enter in Title | **Pass.** It saved, and no tab opened: Save is the form's first submit button, before the preview's Open | — |\n| Unpublish, then Publish, from the save bar | **Pass.** Each landed back on the edit page with the Confirmation, the badge changed, and Unpublish/Publish swapped | — |\n| Edit a Report, dark | **Pass.** As above, with the attached PDF and Remove file, then Replace PDF, then Chart images, under the Editor. Fonts loaded; no sideways scroll | `console-edit-report-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| A Chart card, dark | **Pass.** Its series in the public colours (`#6352d6`, `#a99cff`), with a \"Chart\" head and Edit / Remove | `console-edit-chart-card-1440-768-390-dark.jpg` |\n| The Chart builder, light | **Pass.** Square fields in Atkinson, the grid in Mono, the drawn chart in purples, \"Update chart\" the one solid action | `console-chart-builder-1440-light.jpg` |\n| A locked Report, as the Analyst | **Pass.** The read-only view in the two columns: Address, Summary, Attached file, and the Site preview. The bar shows the badge and \"Only the Director can edit, unpublish, or delete a published Report.\", with no actions | `console-report-locked-analyst-1440-768-390-light.jpg` |\n| A refused save of a title only, as the Analyst | **Pass.** 400, the message beside the Address field, the field outlined red, and \"Unsaved changes\" on. The bar has Unpublish and Save, no Delete | — |\n\nFixed during the check, in `2476d87`:\n- \"Address\" had no space above it.\n- At 390 px the save bar stranded Delete on the State line.\n- A Chart card's head and a locked block's note took paragraph margins.\n- The file inputs' buttons stayed browser-grey.\n\n**Contrast** (WCAG ratio, light / dark), new pairs:\n\n| Pair | Light | Dark |\n|---|---|---|\n| \"Unsaved changes\" (ink on surface) | 18.27 | 14.98 |\n| Save bar State, hints, unpressed toggle (muted on surface) | 6.78 | 6.93 |\n| Address folder and `.html`, link marks, locked note (muted on tint) | 5.87 | 6.71 |\n| Pressed toggle (white on Kenyon) | 10.38 | 10.38 |\n| Delete, Remove chart (danger on surface) | 6.54 | 7.94 |\n| Edit chart, Open (purple on surface) | 10.38 | 7.67 |\n| The Editor's focus ring (bright on surface, non-text) | 3.13 | 4.63 |\n\n**Not checked:**\n- Safari.\n- Windows High Contrast mode.\n- The leave warning on Publish with unsaved edits (see the Spec table).\n- The Chart builder at 390 px. Its layout rules are unchanged from T17's phone check; only its colours and type changed.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 28 --body-file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/64357a30-87f1-41b4-b8f9-9b3ad7295b77/scratchpad/t23/closing.md","description":"Post review and browser-check comment on #28"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1137,"cache_read_input_tokens":288296,"output_tokens":3527,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":328},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1137,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3527,"cache_read_input_tokens":288296,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1137,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1137},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_017hpXzmFHECf7GxH922zwLy":{"command":"cd /Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/64357a30-87f1-41b4-b8f9-9b3ad7295b77/scratchpad/t23/closing.md <<'EOF'\n## Code review (`/code-review` since `49c84df`), and how each finding was resolved\n\n#### Standards\n\n| Finding | Kind | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| `report_edit.html` wrote the file-remove path by hand, `\"/admin/reports/\" ~ id ~ \"/file/delete\"`, though the route has a name | Standard (T22 moved links onto routes) | **Fixed**: `path_for('remove_file', …)`.
