Size the harness from `innerWidth - 40`, not a fixed 1340, or the 390 frame is clipped.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive","originalFile":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T19:47:27.707Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **768/1440 px and dark mode work through a same-origin iframe harness** (T19, 2026-10-01): serve the scratch `cms publish` export plus a harness page with `python -m http.server`, put iframes at 1440/768/390 px side by side scaled with `transform: scale()` (their `innerWidth` stays true, so media queries apply), and force dark by setting each `prefers-color-scheme: dark` CSSMediaRule's `media.mediaText = \"all\"` inside the frame. Print: same trick on `@media print`. Report `document.fonts` statuses and `scrollWidth > innerWidth` in the harness's status line.\n- **Screenshot `scale` also shrinks the saved file**: use scale 1 with `save_to_disk` for anything going in docs/screenshots.\n- **Programmatic `.focus()` in a frame doesn't match `:focus`** (no window focus); press real Tab keys on the page itself (the first Tab lands in browser chrome).\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` passwords set by env, so checks never touch the real `cms.db`.\n- The user has accepted \"not checked\" for Safari and 768/1440 on T15 and T16, recorded on the issue.\n- **Click by element ref, not coordinates**: the screenshot coordinate frame switches between e.g. 1372×872 and 1200×763 within one session, so coordinate clicks miss (T18 typed a description into the body). Use `find` refs.\n- **Leaving a dirty Editor page** without the beforeunload dialog: add a submit listener that calls `preventDefault()`, then dispatch a synthetic `SubmitEvent` on the form. The Editor's own listener sets its \"leaving\" flag, and nothing is posted.\n- **Submitting forms** (T20, 2026-10-01): a ref click on a submit button, and `type` into a header search field, sometimes do nothing. `form_input` to set values plus `form.requestSubmit(button)` from `javascript_tool` works; check the Confirmation afterwards rather than trusting the click. Don't await across the submit's navigation in the same script (it errors \"Inspected target navigated\").\n- **Viewport harness file**: `render_site` wipes its output folder, so write the harness page into the export *after* publishing (T20 kept it at `<scratch>/t20/site/harness.html`, with `?page=&dark=1&h=`). Filter `document.fonts` to `Atkinson*`: the browser adds its own faces (Inter, Super Sans) to the list.\n- **Console pages at 1440/768/390** (T21, 2026-10-01): no export needed. Sign in, open any `/admin` page, and from `javascript_tool` replace its body with three same-origin iframes of the page under test (same dark-mode trick). `fetch('/admin.css', {cache: \"reload\"})` first after a CSS edit. Also test the bar with a **long user name** (set one in the scratch DB with sqlite3): T21's first breakpoint let \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\" squeeze the nav at 900 px, which the short demo names hid.\n- **Measure a contrast claim before writing it**: T21's draft said bright purple failed on the field; it measured 5.35/4.62 and passed.\n- **A cached editor.js** can survive a server restart; `fetch(src, {cache: \"reload\"})` then navigate again.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":["   node_type: memory","   type: reference","   originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437","-  modified: 2026-10-01T19:47:27.707Z","+  modified: 2026-10-01T23:16:24.797Z"," ---"," "," Browser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:"]},{"oldStart":27,"oldLines":4,"newStart":27,"newLines":5,"lines":[" - **Viewport harness file**: `render_site` wipes its output folder, so write the harness page into the export *after* publishing (T20 kept it at `<scratch>/t20/site/harness.html`, with `?page=&dark=1&h=`). Filter `document.fonts` to `Atkinson*`: the browser adds its own faces (Inter, Super Sans) to the list."," - **Console pages at 1440/768/390** (T21, 2026-10-01): no export needed. Sign in, open any `/admin` page, and from `javascript_tool` replace its body with three same-origin iframes of the page under test (same dark-mode trick). `fetch('/admin.css', {cache: \"reload\"})` first after a CSS edit. Also test the bar with a **long user name** (set one in the scratch DB with sqlite3): T21's first breakpoint let \"Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi\" squeeze the nav at 900 px, which the short demo names hid."," - **Measure a contrast claim before writing it**: T21's draft said bright purple failed on the field; it measured 5.35/4.62 and passed.","+- **The Editor's body (contenteditable) and the save bar** (T23, 2026-10-01): a ref click on the body didn't focus it (typing went nowhere), but a coordinate click from a fresh screenshot did. A Report's PDF and chart images sit under the Editor.\n- **Save bar:** pinned to the bottom. It now shows the marker, and the Editor warns before you leave.\n- **Standards:** paths now come from route names, and \"Address\" is in `CONTEXT.md`. It found four layout problems, all fixed:\n- no space above the Address field\n- Delete stranded on its own line in the save bar on a phone\n- extra margins on the Chart card's header\n- browser-grey \"Choose File\" buttons\n\n**Not checked:**\n- Safari.\n- The leave warning when you Publish with unsaved edits.
